articleTitle: Predictive Modeling of Cardiovascular Disease Using ML Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: One of the most significant contributors to morbidity in the global population is the ability to forecast a heart attack. Clinical data analysis is considered one of the most significant aspects for making a forecast, and that aspect is cardiovascular illness, a highly important disease. This can be a very useful tool. Using ML to its full potential, this investigation aims to achieve improved accuracy in diagnosing cardiac disease. In this research, we provide a machine knowledge heart attack diagnosis (MLHAP) technique that involves the study of different risk indicators, and prediction for heart attacks is carried out via ML methodologies, including Support Vector Machines, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, Knn, and XGBoost. In this method, the ML-HAP method predicts heart attacks. This approach aims to reduce the mortality rate from heart attacks. The forecast has been optimized as much as possible based on many parameters, which has been the primary focus. KNN, with its parameters optimized, made the most accurate prediction of any of the algorithms. The accuracy obtained using KNN Optimization is 85.24, while the accuracy obtained using Logistic Regression is 78.68. The prediction made by machine learning models for recognizing the signs of a heart attack is extremely effective, particularly when using boosting algorithms.

articleTitle: Yolo5-Based UAV Surveillance for Tiny Object Detection on Airport Runways
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Foreign Object Debris (FOD) present on runways poses a threat to various aircraft components, including the frame, windshield, tires, and engine, while also posing a risk of injury to personnel in the surrounding area. The spectrum of foreign objects includes small rocks, pebbles, nuts, bolts, metal pieces, papers, and objects of millimetric sizes. Currently, a substantial number of air personnel engage in manual runway inspections to identify FOD, a process that demands significant manpower. Conducting visual inspections becomes challenging. An automated object detection framework has been developed to enhance the efficiency of the detection process and minimize dependence on human resources. Utilizing YOLOv5, this study explores Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) surveillance for precise detection of small objects on airport runways. The focus is on enhancing efficiency and accuracy in monitoring runway spaces prone to Foreign Object Debris (FOD). The integration of YOLOv5 technology offers a robust solution for proactive detection and maintenance of runway safety.

articleTitle: Efficient Crop yield Analysis Prediction in Modern Agriculture System using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In agriculture, yield estimation accuracy is crucial. To increase production while decreasing operational costs and environmental effects, remote sensing systems are increasingly being employed in developing decision-support tools for modern agricultural systems. However, because RS-based technologies need to analyze vast quantities of remotely sensed data from many platforms, more focus is being placed on machine learning techniques. This is because systems based on machine learning can handle non-linear tasks and process a huge number of inputs. To make decisions about which crops to plant and what to do when they are in the growing season, machine learning is an essential decision-making tool for forecasting agricultural yields. Several other machine learning methods have been used, too. We are taking into account a few factors that influence crop productivity. The variables include rainfall, PH, temperature, humidity, and nutrients. A machine learning model will be created utilising the data retrieved from these parameters in order to assess and forecast the ideal crop using machine learning.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Severity Detection in Alzheimer's Disease: A Comprehensive Study on Cognitive Impairment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a neurodegenerative disorder affecting millions worldwide, causing cognitive decline. Early detection is crucial for effective treatment, but manual diagnosis is error-prone and time-consuming. This study proposes a deep learning-based model for diagnosing and classifying Alzheimer's disease using VGG-16 CNN architectures. The model uses the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) dataset, which includes MRI scans from individuals with Alzheimer's and healthy controls. The model uses a pre-trained VGG-16 convolutional neural network as the base, fine-tuning on the dataset, and data augmentation techniques. The trained model achieves a 96.75% accuracy on the testing dataset, distinguishing MRI scans between Alzheimer's patients and healthy controls. The VGG-16 architecture demonstrated superior performance during training and testing.

articleTitle: Enhancing Fault Tolerance in Wireless Mesh Networks through Adaptive and Resilient Routing Protocols
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: From smart cities to disaster response systems, Wireless Mesh Networks (WMNs) are an essential component of many different kinds of infrastructure. Their great sensitivity to different types of errors, however, makes it very difficult to maintain trustworthy communication. The goal of this research is to improve WMN fault tolerance by developing new resilient and adaptive routing algorithms. The main goal is to detect faults in real-time using dynamic algorithms that can detect and react to disturbances including link failures, node unavailability, and changes in the environment. On top of that, the research suggests adaptive routing algorithms that may respond to changing network conditions, improve communication pathways, and avoid broken parts. In the meanwhile, we look at resilient topology control methods, which stress the need to keep a strong network architecture with features like redundancy, load balancing, and quick adaptability to topological changes.This research takes a novel tack by combining machine learning models for fault prediction and proactive repair. These models add to a predictive fault-tolerance paradigm by using network patterns and historical data, which further strengthens the network’s resilience. Included in the thorough evaluation of the protocols created in this paper are simulations and real experiments. These evaluations cover important performance metrics like latency, throughput, and overall network reliability. The study reveals the suggested protocols’ strengths and weaknesses by a thorough comparison with current fault-tolerant routing methods. By laying the groundwork for resilient and adaptive fault-tolerant communication in complex and ever-changing contexts, the results ultimately help wireless mesh networks progress.

articleTitle: Optimizing Forensic Investigation and Security Surveillance with Deep Reinforcement Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has emerged as a useful method for improving both accuracy and efficiency in advanced forensic analysis and security surveillance. This research gives the findings of a thorough assessment of the use of DRL methodologies, providing a full picture of its performance metrics, forensic analysis capabilities, security surveillance efficacy, and computational efficiency. Our DRL model performed admirably, with an accuracy of 92% and precision, recall, and F1 score metrics demonstrating robust capability for classification tasks. The average Intersection over Union (IOU) score of 86% demonstrates its spatial awareness. When compared to previous approaches, our model had a much higher detection rate (95%) while keeping a low false positive rate (3%). The hybrid strategy produced a balanced performance, with a detection rate of 92%, by using the capabilities of both DRL and classical techniques. Our DRL model consistently outperformed 90% detection rates in various surveillance scenarios, including indoor, outdoor, and night-time environments, while retaining a low false alarm rate. This demonstrates its flexibility and dependability in real-world security applications. Despite the complexity of DRL models, our model’s training period was 48 hours, and the inference time for real-time analysis was only 15 milliseconds per frame. These gains demonstrate the utility of our technique for use in dynamic security surveillance systems.

articleTitle: Decentralized Hybrid Intrusion Detection System for Cyber Attack Identification using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This research proposes a hybrid intrusion detection system that uses machine learning, file integrity monitoring, anomaly-based and signature-based rootkit detection, and signature-and anomaly-based detection. A distributed architecture is also used in my research to share real-time threat intelligence among numerous nodes. The system offers proactive response methods for automatic incident response, endpoint quarantine, and improved detection capabilities.This hybrid intrusion detection system combines rule-based and machine-learning algorithms to detect and prevent cyberattacks better. The system utilizes decentralized storage and distribution of alerts, improving scalability and availability. The main objective of this project is to develop highly effective and efficient IDS that can detect and prevent cyber attacks in real time. The proposed hybrid approach combines rule-based and machine-learning algorithms to achieve better detection rates and reduce false positives. The system architecture consists of a central server and multiple agents deployed across the network to collect data from various sources. The collected data is analyzed using rule-based and machine-learning techniques to identify potential threats. Alerts are then sent to the central server, which distributes them to the relevant agents for further analysis and response.The machine learning models are trained using a large dataset of normal and attack traffic, and the system continuously learns and adapts to new attack techniques. Using decentralized storage ensures that alerts are always available, even during network disruptions or server failures. The effectiveness of the proposed system was evaluated using various performance metrics, including detection rate, false positive rate, and response time.The results indicate the system achieves high detection rates while minimizing false positives and response times. Overall, the proposed system provides a comprehensive solution for intrusion detection and prevention, combining the strengths of rule-based and machine-learning techniques while also offering high scalability and availability through decentralized storage and distribution of alerts.

articleTitle: Legal Case Classification Using Machine Learning with NLP
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In India, offences occur daily; crime can be minor or severe. The Indian jurisdiction system provides justice in every severity of the case. However, reporting a crime to get justice requires proper steps. Cases involving murder fall under criminal cases, while cases related to a family dispute over a property fall under civil cases. Accurately dividing legal circumstances into civil and criminal categories is essential for efficient legal case management and decision-making processes. In recent years, deep learning models have advanced significantly in problems in evolving natural language processing. This study offers a strategy based on BERT for classifying legal cases as civil or criminal. The recommended model fine-tunes the early halting and modifies the BERT-Base model using a hyperparameter on a corpus of labelled court case documents, using BERT’s ability to gather contextual information and precise relationships between words and sentences. The attention mechanism in BERT enables the model to understand the nuances of the legal dataset and distinguish between civil and criminal scenarios based on the given legal context. Experimental results on a large dataset of legal cases show our method’s effectiveness and excellent accuracy, precision, recall, and F1score in categorizing legal cases. The BERT-based model exhibits promising potential for automating case categorization, enabling efficient case management, assisting legal professionals in decision-making processes, and assisting regular people in making informed decisions by providing insightful analyses and predictions based on the available data, with an accuracy of 92.9 and an F1 score of 0.93.

articleTitle: A Medical Chatbot Embedding with Artificial Intelligence for Self-Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Healthcare is essential for a healthy existence. Scheduling a doctor's appointment for each health concern, however, could be incredibly difficult. Statistics show that most people already have heart or lung illness, even though many report never having been to a doctor. Most people do not have the medical knowledge to assess or diagnose their health issues accurately. In advanced human-computer interaction, natural language processing research is creating natural interaction modes like chatbots. Corporate and commercial applications are using chatbots to answer user enquiries in natural language. The objective is to create an artificial intelligence-powered medical chatbot that can diagnose illnesses and offer guidance on how to manage them effectively prior to the need for direct consultation with a physician. The suggested chatbot model acquires information about their health and then provides personalized responses and suggestions for dealing with each user's health issues while lowering healthcare expenses.

articleTitle: Loan Prediction Analysis Using Innumerable Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)

authors.preferredName: K. V. S. Sai Ram Santosh Babu

abstract: One of the most fundamental issues that banks and other financial institutions must deal with is loan prediction because it has a big impact on profits. Even though there are several established methods for extracting data from loan applications, most of them seem to be functioning poorly given the reported increase in the number of subprime loans. Gradient boosting, an Extreme Gradient Boosting approach, is used in this work to forecast loan default. Statistics on loans from the internet lending company Super Lender corroborate the prediction. We review demographic data and information from the loan application. The F1-Score, Accuracy, Recall, and Precision area of the investigation are among the critical evaluation metrics we list here. This study provides a strong foundation for loan credit approval by identifying risky clients from a large pool of loan applications using predictive modeling.

articleTitle: Quality Enhancement for Uninvited Content of Social Media Using Support Vector Machine and Alexnet
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The objective of the work is to identify the uninvited content like Spam and Ham data in Reddit using Support Vector Machine over AlexNet. To acquire the accuracy, an innovative SVM Classifier function was used. The assortment of information and its pre-processing are examined. For the review, almost 20 samples were taken and 10 for each group to assess, look at and figure out the exactness of proposed calculations. For accuracy expectation, a G power of 80 % and the parameters Confidence Interval of 0.95, alpha 0.05 and beta 0.2 is utilized. From observation, the support vector machine with accuracy of 95.72 % is inferred to have higher accuracy in identifying the unsolicited content and avoid data theft, and its threshold is higher than the AlexNet method with an accuracy of 93.47 %, and with a statistical significance of p is 0.003 (p < 0.05), it is statistically significant. The social media platform was made so that people could talk to each other and share how they feel. But a lot of information is being stolen. A lot of the scams make profiles and collect information about other people. This research shows how important it is to be able to spot fraudsters on social media. Scammers were found using two different algorithms, SVM and AlexNet. Among those, the suggested SVM did well and figured out the unsolicited content and ham data to avoid data.

articleTitle: Driver Drowsiness Detection System using OpenCV and Keras
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Unfortunately, occurring number of accidents in nowadays hugely, it will be effect on human loss or injury and property damage like cars. It can find in the event of an accident with the help of image of person which is taking as input by webcam and evaluating how this information. articleTitle: Wood Type Identification via Neural Networks and Spectral Analysis: An Advanced Algorithmic Solution
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Forestry management, woodworking, and manufacturing need wood type identification. This study introduces a neural network-spectral analysis technique for accurate and automatic wood type detection. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is used to extract features from a heterogeneous collection of wood spectral signatures after training a neural network. The algorithm’s 94.2% accuracy on a testing dataset shows its ability to distinguish wood kinds.The model’s confusion matrix shows it can recognise closely related wood species with few misclassifications. The neural network’s precision, recall, and F1 score prove its wood classification accuracy. With PCA highlighting classification characteristics, spectral analysis helps the algorithm succeed.The method is useful for forestry management and woodworking quality control. The non-destructive technology provides in-situ wood type detection, addressing environmental and conservation issues. The study explores ramifications, constraints, and future algorithm modification and application in real-world contexts.Neural networks and spectral analysis provide a strong, efficient, and non-destructive wood type detection solution. The hopeful results represent a major advance in wood science and current computer methods, with applicability across sectors.

articleTitle: Voice Authentication System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Voice authentication is a system that recognises and validates an individual’s identification with their voice. This form of biometric system is extremely effective and accurate at processing speech frequency patterns. Voice authentication, security and surveillance, and identity verification all make use of speech recognition. But speaker identification is a tight spot to provide solution because collating voices of different speakers for their identification might become hard to predict as the voice of a person may change due to the way they express their emotion, frequency modulation or due to sore throat. Conversely when an individual tries to say the same comment different times, a there exist a lot of difference in the frequency and pitch of a single speaker’s voice. And as a result, a robust voice comparison system is necessary because it can be used in many fields, such as authentication/authorization, security/surveillance, etc. To achieve this, the following techniques are performed in a specific order, i.e., Voice recognition, Voice Identification, and Voice Verification/Authentication. This paper analyzes traditional and deep learning approach to find a better solution to the problem of voice identification of various individuals. The paper also discusses and analyzes the datasets collected manually for speaker recognition and voice identification.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Fusion: CNN-LSTM Hybrid for Robust COVID-19 Forecasting and Spatial Localization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The corona virus was first identified in Wuhan, China and has spread around the globe. Around 1.8 million people have been infected, with 114,698 people dying as a result. Due to the number of instances has increased rapidly, most of the countries are experiencing a lack of testing kits and resources. Previous prediction method is based only on the historical data. So the prediction accuracy is less, here the external factors are also necessary to analyze the number of cases that will occur. The method proposed is based on by integrating CNN and LSTM framework to assist radiologist and clinicians in recognising COVID-19 cases in X ray images. The main aim of this work is to predict cases from the data sets available in online. The prediction is done by using Convolutional neural network and LSTM approach. The proposed work performs better than existing methods in-terms of accuracy in prediction.

articleTitle: Transformative Approaches in Brain Tumor Detection: Harnessing Deep Learning from MRI Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This research uses deep learning algorithms on Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) data to address the urgent need for accurate and effective brain tumour diagnosis. The increasing prevalence of brain tumors underscores the importance of robust and automated diagnostic tools. CNN, a subset of deep learning, have demonstrated effectiveness in image analysis tasks, making them well-suited for medical image classification. The study commences with the acquisition and preprocessing of a diverse dataset encompassing both normal and tumor-affected brain MRI images. The data is meticulously curated, normalized, and augmented to enhance the model’s generalization capabilities. A novel deep learning architecture, inspired by established networks such as VGG and ResNet, is proposed for tumor detection. The model is trained on the preprocessed dataset, employing appropriate loss functions and optimization algorithms. Rigorous validation procedures ensure that the model avoids overfitting to the training data, while hyper-parameter tuning optimizes its overall performance. Thorough testing on a separate dataset evaluates the model’s generalization ability and accuracy in detecting brain tumors. Through the implementation of this approach, the CNN classifier achieves an impressive accuracy of approximately 94.1%.

articleTitle: Machine Vision for Driver Safety: YOLOv5-powered Real-time Drowsiness Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Drowsiness significantly threatens road safety, contributing to numerous accidents and fatalities worldwide. Many incidents could be prevented by alerting drivers when they exhibit drowsiness. The peril of drowsy driving extends beyond merely falling asleep at the wheel; it encompasses instances where drivers are not fully engaged with the road, potentially leading to momentary lapses of consciousness. Video data, captured by a dashboard-installed camera, is the basis for extracting relevant features. Unlike traditional methods that often rely on behavioral indicators, some of which can be intrusive and distracting, or necessitate costly sensor setups, our approach addresses these challenges. This paper presents a lightweight, real-time driver drowsiness detection system implemented as a web application. The system utilizes facial landmarks, computes metrics such as Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR) and Eye Closure Ratio (ECR), and employs adaptive thresholding for drowsiness detection. Machine learning algorithms, specifically the YOLOv5 classifier, are integrated to assess the effectiveness of the proposed methodology. Empirical findings highlight the system’s capability to achieve an accuracy of 91%, showcasing the potential of YOLOv5 in enhancing driver safety through efficient drowsiness detection.

articleTitle: A Multi-Model Approach for Predicting Churn Customers using Longitudinal Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Due to the dynamic nature of the Retail market and increased competition among the major players to attract customers, it is becoming increasingly important to focus on customer retention. Also, attaining a new customer is usually costlier than retention. The first step prior to retaining customers is to first identify potential churn customers. Hence, it’s important to identify the customers who are about to churn and address the pain points. Typically churn modeling is performed on cross-sectional data, and the results provide an overall effect of each variable on the entire data set. This creates a loss of information about the temporal behavior of customers. In this paper, a new framework is proposed to overcome these shortcomings. A multi-model approach is followed to account for both cross-sectional as well as temporal data for predicting the churn probability of a customer. Focus is kept on retaining high-value customers, and probable customer-specific features leading to churn are derived to help the business act more precisely. Customer profiling is integrated with the results to enable the business to make more informed decisions and act at a customer cohort level. A comparative study between the proposed new framework and the traditional RFM model shows a significant improvement in the results using the proposed framework.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Boosted LSTM Recurrent Neural Network Approach for Aircraft Maintenance Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In aviation, predictive maintenance is essential for raising aircraft safety, cutting downtime, and optimizing maintenance schedules. The proposed research introduces a new method for forecasting aviation maintenance using a hybrid model Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) with Gradient Boosting (GB). The suggested GB-LSTM methodology uses historical data on sensor readings, maintenance records, aircraft operations and failure incidences to create a predictive model that can predict component failures and calculate remaining usable life (RUL). Component failure prediction, RUL estimate, and anomaly detection are just a few of the duties that are addressed in this article about predictive maintenance. Utilizing metrics that are accepted in the industry, the model’s performance is extensively assessed to guarantee its efficacy and dependability in practical implementations. By providing a reliable and effective solution for predictive maintenance, which has the potential to significantly reduce costs, boost operational effectiveness, and enhance aircraft safety, this research makes a contribution to the aviation sector. The results demonstrate the proposed GB-LSTM potential as a useful Neural Network algorithm for predicting airplane maintenance.

articleTitle: Smart Optimization of Biogas Production for Enhanced Gas Yield
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This study presents a novel approach to enhance biogas generation by integrating the capabilities of the Internet of Things (IoT) with organic waste recycling. Although organic waste can be harnessed to produce biogas, the conventional process can be time-intensive. To optimize equipment control, this research leverages IoT technology, involving the connection of sensors to the internet. Continuous monitoring of critical parameters such as temperature, acidity levels, waste volume, flow rate, waste composition, and gas production rate is imperative. The proposed Smart Optimized Biogas Production (SOBP) system employs advanced computational analyses and machine learning techniques to dynamically adjust and stimulate the system's internal conditions while it operates. Specifically, temperature and acidity levels are adapted based on the type of waste being processed. This strategy aims to expedite biogas production while maintaining an efficient and eco-friendly process. The potential outcomes of this study are promising, including accelerated energy production, reduced resource consumption, and a transition toward innovative and sustainable energy solutions.

articleTitle: Forecasting the Electricity Demand of Tamil Nadu using Ant Colony Optimization Technique Based on Linear and Non-Linear Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The foremost concerns in emerging nations have to predict the electricity demand for in well advance is good. The socioeconomic factors have been used to analytically define the required electricity demand for future projection. In this paper required demand of power in Mega Watt (MW) has been forecasted for Tamil Nadu up to year 2035 using Ant Colony Optimization (ACO). The linear model and non-linear model have been adopted for this paper to enhance the results. The difficult issue has been identified that finding of ideal weighting parameters in training the observed data or historical data. The optimum weighting parameters have been estimated using ACO. Numbers of people, individual revenue and State Gross Domestic Product (state GDP) have been selected as input variable. The required demand of power in MW has been selected as output variable for this study. For future prediction, three cases such as case 1, case 2 and case 3 has been made up to the year 2035. Moreover, the future prediction results have been compared with National Electricity Plan of India.

articleTitle: Customer Sale Analysis and Classification Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Large-scale sale Prediction involves analyzing the sales based on client interests and needs. Analyzing the product’s demand based on sales. This has further advantages for marketing and business, helping them to increase sales and productivity. To execute and forecast the sales, machine learning techniques were needed. Business intelligence is crucial for sales and product development. The forecasting of big-box store sales considers several variables, including historical sales data, consumer demographics, market trends, seasonal effects, promotional activities, and macroeconomic situations. Machine learning algorithms that predict sales have a significant impact on accuracy. The many elements can teach the models new things. Other methods for forecasting and analyzing sales include targeted marketing and consumer segmentation. To forecast and evaluate sales, linear regression models, decision trees, random forests, etc. will be helpful. Big Mart sales forecasting is necessary for business decision-making and market-condition alteration. The system being developed in this study is one that can forecast with accuracy. A few measures, including mean squared error, mean absolute error, and R squared, can be used to assess the performance of the model. After training and evaluation, the model may be used to forecast sales of new goods or shops. This model provided an accuracy of above 90%.

articleTitle: Assessing The Impact of Bias in Training Data on the Fairness and Equity of Predictive Policing Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In the evolving landscape of predictive policing, our project aims to unravel the intricate dynamics between training data bias and the overarching principles of fairness and equity. With the proliferation of data-driven methodologies, our study critically examines the extent to which biases inherent in training datasets can shape and influence the outcomes of predictive policing models. This paper critically examines the repercussions of bias present in training data on the equitable and fair deployment of predictive policing models. Through a comprehensive analysis, we investigate the complexities surrounding biased training datasets and their profound influence on the fairness and equity of predictive policing outcomes. The research delves into strategies for assessing and mitigating bias, encompassing conscious bias mitigation, diverse data collection, fairness-aware model training, and continuous monitoring. By emphasizing ethical considerations and community engagement, our study aims to contribute insights into crafting more equitable and just predictive policing practices.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Approach to Estimate Continuous Blood Pressure From Photoplethysmography
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Abnormal blood pressure (BP) necessitates continuous monitoring to mitigate health risks. Traditional methods like sphygmomanometers are accurate but unsuitable for continuous monitoring. Photoplethysmography (PPG) signals offer an alternative for BP estimation. This study proposes a novel machine learning-based method for blood pressure estimation using PPG signal features. Pre-processing techniques, including normalization, baseline correction, and filtering, enhance signal quality. Fiducial points such as systolic peaks, inflection points, and diastolic peaks are automatically detected from processed PPG signals. Various morphological and timing-based features are extracted from these points. Machine learning algorithms, including Linear Regression, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Gaussian Process Regression (GPR), and Decision Tree, are trained with these features to estimate systolic and diastolic blood pressures. Evaluation on a dataset of 657 PPG signals from 219 subjects shows that the cubic support vector machine (CSVM) provides superior accuracy for systolic blood pressure (SBP) estimation, while Gaussian support vector machine (GSVM) outperforms other methods for diastolic blood pressure (DBP) estimation. The proposed method conforms to the standards set by the Association for the Advancements of Medical Instrumentation (AAMI) for BP measurement compatibility. Comparison with other studies demonstrates favorable performance. The machine learning-based method accurately estimates SBP and DBP using PPG signal features, eliminating the need for cuff-based measurement, and enabling continuous monitoring in various applications. This approach has potential for developing commercial prototypes for accurate BP estimation. It holds promise for continuous BP monitoring in research and clinical settings, facilitating baroreflex gain assessment and minimizing instrumentation requirements for physiological signal monitoring.

Author Keywords: Association for the Advancements of Medical Instrumentation (AAMI)

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling for Air Quality: A Machine Learning System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Air pollution poses significant health risks to humans, emphasizing the importance of predicting air quality to mitigate its adverse effects. Our objective is to forecast the Air Quality Index (AQI) for India using machine learning techniques, predicting pollutant levels The model demonstrates proficiency in predicting AQI for the entire country, specific states, or localized regions by leveraging historical data on pollutant concentrations. Given the current global environmental challenge of pollution, our focus is on four key air pollutants: respirable particulate matter, nitrogen oxide, particulate matter, and sulfur dioxide. To address this concern, we have collected an extensive dataset of air quality information from monitoring stations worldwide. This dataset undergoes analysis for forecasting future AQI. This helps to support continuing global efforts to address air pollution.

articleTitle: Multi-Object Recognition and Segmentation using Enhanced Mask R-CNN for Intricate Image Scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Vision based object revealing and dissection have been imperative investigation area for autonomous driving atmosphere detection, although conventional object detection and segmentation methods suffer from low finding precision and insufficient mask dissection value to find and segment multiple objects. Complex traffic views. This paper upgraded the R-CNN mask to solve this problem by supplanting the ResNet trunk network through a ResNeXt network that uses group convolution to significantly improve model and feature discrimination. Ensemble convolution significantly progresses model and feature resolution. In this investigation, the R-CNN mask was improved by using the ResNeXt network instead of the ResNet trunk network. Taken from the visibly presented CityScapes dataset for independent driving. The study outcomes disclosed that the modified Mask R-CNN algorithm outperformed the original algorithm by 4.73% and 3.96%, respectively, achieving 67.92% mAP for object finding and 62.59% mAP for segmentation accuracy.

articleTitle: A Lightweight CNN Model for Breast Cancer Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Breast cancer is a dominant cancer worldwide and is increasing in developing countries where the majority of cases are diagnosed in later stage. Early detection of cancer helps to control it in the early stage itself and decrease the death rate. There were over 2 million new cases in 2021, making it a significant health problem in present days. Malignant is the cancer cells that invade and kill nearby tissue and spread into different parts of the body. Unlike Malignant, Benign does not invade to other parts of the body. The key challenge is to classify the tumor as malignant or benign. To cater to this problem, novel Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture is introduced to identify and classify the tumor as either malignant or benign. The proposed CNN model is experimented on the Wisconsin Breast Cancer Dataset (WBCD) and it is able to achieve 99% of accuracy.

articleTitle: Multimodal Fusion of Transformer with Attention Mechanism for Improved Contextual Image Captioning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Image captioning can provide automatic annotations or labels for images, describing the objects, scenes or activities present in the image. This can be beneficial in applications that require large-scale image analysis such as image recognition, recommendation systems and content classification. Traditional methods for generating image descriptions rely on rule-based systems, which are time consuming and lack the ability to capture the contextual details of complex images. The proposed method combines the power of two state-of the-art models: attention mechanism and Transformer. Attention mechanism is a powerful model for multimodal understanding that combines the domains of vision and language processing. Attention mechanism leverages pertaining on large-scale datasets to capture semantic relationships between images and text. By combining the multimodal understanding of attention mechanism with the sequence modelling capabilities of Transformer, superior performance in image captioning task can be achieved. The model can better capture complicated context dependence in input captions by adding more transformer layers. The suggested system's performance is assessed using BLEU-1,2,3,4 and other objective evaluation criteria.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Corrosion Damage Analysis Using FEM with ACO
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The results of an experiment on the corrosion damage of M30 grade RC beams with manufactured sand (M-sand) are presented in this study. For this experiment, National Bureau of Standards (NBS) eight beams were cast, and they underwent three degrees of accelerated corrosion testing using a sodium chloride (NaCl) solution: 5%, 10%, and 25%. Throughout the test procedure, the currents were observed and any cracks were visually inspected. All of the beams were tested for failure after the rebar had experienced a significant percentage of steel loss. The experimental outcomes were validated with analytical results obtained from ANSYS. The obtained experimental results were optimized using ANT colony optimization (ACO)

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Classification of Flowers Using FlowerNet Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Achieving the rapid and accurate detection of flowers in the natural environment is not easy, the study of floral classification systems is a crucial topic. However, there are still some difficulties in the recognition of flower photos due to the complicated backgrounds of flowers, the similarities between the many kinds of flowers, and the differences within the same species of flowers. The conventional classification of flowers is mostly based on the three characteristics of color, shape, and texture; however, the accuracy of this classification is not very high.

articleTitle: Efficient GPU-based Gridding and Segmentation of Microarray Images via K-Means and Fuzzy C-Means
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The analysis of microarray image helps in identifying new genes that enables us to understand their functions and gene expression levels simultaneously at different conditions. This is also useful in diagnosing the various diseases and helps in develop the treatment for the required disease. In general it has 3 stages, the first one is gridding, and the second segmentation and the third one is intensity extraction. In this paper we are going to discuss various machine learning techniques in segmenting the microarray images. This proposed algorithm eliminates the noise and enhances the image quality by finding the nearest spots in segmentation and enhancing the spot using KNN algorithm. The performance can be improved further by the efficient utilization of a graphics processing unit (GPU). It is also shown that the method can be employed to produce a model on health based on a PET-MRI dataset which can be utilized to automatically detect pathology in the imaging.

articleTitle: Deep-Q Classifier for Predicting Balanced and Imbalanced Features in Cartpole and Lunarlander Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to investigate the impact of Significant Q-Assignment (SQN) on the convenience of multiclass portrayal estimations. To create a framework that blends DQN with existing supervised multiclass classification algorithms, we will utilize a Kaggle benchmark dataset. The findings of this review will provide insight on how to utilize profound support learning methods to enhance multiclass order precision. They have been used in different fields, including picture affirmation, normal language processing, and bioinformatics. The specialist demonstrates one example at each time point, and the climate evaluates the order activity and gives the specialist a prize. The specialist is more attentive to the minority class due to the higher prize for minority class tests. The agent ultimately discovers the optimal classification policy in the data with imbalances, guided by a specific reward function and a beneficial learning environment.

articleTitle: Defending FinTech: A Novel Approach to Credit Card Validation using Binary Pattern Features in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Fraud is misappropriating a profit organization’s system that does not always result in immediate legal penalties. Credit card firms must be able to spot fraudulent credit card transactions so that customers aren’t charged for goods they didn’t buy. Nowadays, misusing of credit cards is increasing day by day. In order to stop these illegal activities, a method has been developed in which credit cards are used fraudulently. The method proposed, local binary pattern (LBP), Local Ternary Pattern (LTP), and Local Gradient Pattern (LGP) for characters and numerals features to train the network utilized to detect fraud in credit cards. By combining all these three patterns, size and space between character and numerical are efficiently validated. In the introduced method 70 percent of the image from the standard database has been used for training and 30 percent test image for testing the trained network. The results of the proposed method achieve better than the existing methods interms of accuracy and 92.24% accuracy is achieved through this proposed method.

articleTitle: Extraction and Validation for Large Document Database by using AI
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: We are stepping into a digital international and the entirety is becoming digital and effortlessly handy. Documents like certificate, applications, bills, receipts, etc., can be lost or damaged of their paperback layout and might be shared without difficulty. Manually changing a large wide variety of files may be tedious and is nearly impossible. Not each document has the identical format, so we need an Intelligent System to do the process. An AI Engine is a tool that facilitates us to construct an artificially clever system. This equipment assists to reiterate obligations which might be repetitive and frequently hard to be carried out by means of a human. The AI engine is used to become aware of the textual content in diverse bureaucracy, receipts, and payments with their respective keys. The extracted content material could be a dictionary item which has the label as its key and its content as its price. These resultant records could be surpassed through the Quality Control device wherein the statistics may be demonstrated manually. The verification records from the Quality Control machine can also be used within the process of schooling the AI Engine and improving its precision to extract content greater exactly in the future. The Quality Control System is an application that showcases numerous forms of files. The aforementioned AI Engine will partner a self-assurance rating with every extraction. Higher the score, the extra accurate the extraction. The self-assurance score may additionally lessen in some instances like damaged/dirty documents, illegible handwriting, and so on., In those scenarios, we need a manual intervention to both verify such extracted fields or maybe to feature inside the fields, if the AI neglected any. This manual Quality Control is probably tedious at the start of the technique, however as soon as the correction comments is looped returned to the AI and it starts off evolved gaining knowledge of, we can get a better end result transferring ahead. The Quality Control System utility might be evolved the usage of React for the front-give up, Nest JS for the lower back-stop and Mongo DB for the database.

articleTitle: Efficient Text Summarization using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In recent years, a huge volume of textual data has been released through social media and various other domains that can be extracted and analyzed to reproduce useful information. The underlying information from the data should be retrieved and summarized within a specific period for effective analysis. Text summarization is the process of condensing a text document into a briefer version while retaining its key information and meaning and understanding the essence of a document. This process enables the user to save time. It has a wide range of applications in various domains such as news articles, scientific papers, legal documents, social media, and more.There are two ways to implement Text summarization: Extractive and Abstractive Summarization. Extractive summarization involves generating summaries from the original text but cannot frame new sentences. Another approach is abstractive summarization, which involves generating new sentences that capture the essence of the original text. Text summarization can significantly reduce the time and effort required to extract important information from large volumes of text. Experimental data can be used to validate the system's effectiveness and fine-tune the various modules involved in the text summarization process.This paper explores the implementation of different text summarization approaches to summarize the text data collected from different sources and analyze their performance using the ROUGE score. The abstractive text summarization method is more effective than the extractive summarization for the given set of input text chosen.

articleTitle: Optimizing Team Composition: Genetic Algorithms vs. Linear Programming in Resource Allocation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The allocation of resources is a crucial undertaking in various fields, and selecting an optimization approach plays a central role in attaining the intended results. The present work aims to conduct a comparative analysis of the performance of Genetic Algorithms (GA) and Linear Programming (LP) in the specific domain of optimizing team composition by means of resource allocation. Several tests and analyses were done to assess the merits and limitations of these two methodologies. The results of our study indicate that the utilization of resources by GA is significantly higher, reaching roughly 92.5%. This finding suggests that GA holds promise as a suitable option when the maximization of resource usage is of utmost importance. Nevertheless, it can be observed that LP regularly exhibits superior performance compared to GA in terms of team composition score. LP achieves an average score of roughly 84.9, which suggests that the solutions generated by LP are more closely matched with the desired team composition. Additionally, analyzing resource allocation among individual team members reveals that GA tends to allocate resources more equitably. In contrast, LP displays a modest inclination towards favoring specific team members. The Genetic Algorithm (GA) exhibits speedier convergence times, with an average convergence time of roughly 321 seconds, in contrast to the average convergence time of 423 seconds observed in Linear Programming (LP). Nevertheless, it is important to acknowledge that the computing resources required for GA are marginally higher, around 95.2%, compared to LP which demands approximately 91.8% of resources.

articleTitle: Securing the Digital Perimeter: A Comprehensive Intrusion Detection System with Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The article introduces an all-inclusive Intrusion Detection System (IDS) for anomaly and misuse detection to handle rising computer network cybersecurity risks. Our intrusion detection system (IDS) design includes anomaly detection using the Self-Organizing Map (SOM) and abuse detection utilizing the Gradient Boosting Algorithm and AdaBoosting Algorithm as ensemble classifiers. For this, we use the large and diverse CICIDS dataset. SOM-based anomaly detection is adaptable to CICIDS dataset patterns. The SOM detects slight anomalies that may indicate intrusions by unsupervised learning of the dynamic nature of network functioning. The modern network is flexible despite complicated and dynamic traffic. The abuse detection module detects dataset attacks well using the Gradient Boosting Algorithm and AdaBoosting Algorithm. Ensemble techniques use multiple weak classifiers to enhance detection accuracy. The system’s success against old and new cyber-attacks shows its adaptability. Our intelligent Intrusion Detection System (IDS) study found amazing findings for network anomaly and abuse detection. We leverage the huge dataset in our IDS architecture. Self-organizing map anomaly detection Gradient Boosting Algorithm and AdaBoosting Algorithm abuse detection are powerful. The CICIDS dataset is appropriate for testing the system’s cyber risk identification and categorization due to its diversity and real-world application. After testing with the dataset and cutting-edge ensemble learning algorithms, the recommended intrusion detection system design appears to solve practical intrusion detection problems. These ensemble algorithms provide a strong defense, demonstrating the system’s ability to warn cybersecurity analysts swiftly and accurately. Research could improve system scalability for big, varied networks and investigate fresh feature engineering methodologies.

articleTitle: Optimizing Pathfinding: A Confluence of Ant Colony Optimization and GBFS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper aims to enhance pathfinding processes to create more efficient travel routes across various domains. It contributes to the development of optimization methodologies, offering valuable insights into the effectiveness of hybrid algorithms when dealing with complex combinatorial problems. Our approach combines the adaptability of ACO (Ant Colony Optimization) with the informed search strategy of GBFS (Greedy Best-First Search). Through extensive experimentation and comparative analysis, we highlight the significant advantages of our hybrid framework when compared to other similar metaheuristic algorithms and heuristic search techniques.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Segmentation/Detection using Transfer Learning with VGG19
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Using transfer learning, we can reuse the previously trained model. Transfer learning involves utilizing knowledge added from an earlier activity. It is most widely used in the three domains i.e. image prediction, image classification, and natural language processing. Nevertheless, training deep learning models from scratch on huge datasets may lead to high computational complexity. To solve this issue, this paper uses transfer learning for image segmentation and prediction. A pre-trained model of VGG19 is employed in this study. The VGG19 is utilized for image segmentation and prediction. The model is implemented on the Google Colab platform because the performance of the model rests on the GPU of the system. The result using the VGG19 model for the task at hand achieved an accuracy of 98.29%.

articleTitle: Improving Emotion Detection in Text: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms and Genetic Algorithm-Optimized Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Emotion detection, a critical task in natural language processing, plays a vital role in understanding and analyzing emotions expressed in text data. This study focuses on Emotion detection of the Tweet_emotions dataset, a challenging multi-class classification problem with 13 emotion classes. We compare the performance of various classifiers, including logistic regression, random forest, SVM, gradient boosting, Naive Bayes, and KNN. We suggest using a genetic algorithm (GA) optimization technique for tweaking the logistic regression classifier’s hyperparameters in order to improve its performance. The experimental results demonstrate that the GA-optimized logistic regression classifier achieved the highest accuracy of 90.07%, outperforming the other classifiers. Our findings contribute to the field of Emotion detection by showcasing the effectiveness of the GA optimization technique in enhancing the performance of logistic regression for multi-class sentiment classification tasks. This research has significant implications for understanding emotions expressed in textual data and can be applied in various domains such as social media analysis, customer feedback analysis, and opinion mining.

articleTitle: Enhancing Glioma Brain Tumor Detection from MRI using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Brain tumor classification from MRI image is one of the important areas in biomedical research. However, the interpretation of these images is subjective, and automated detection methods can improve diagnostic accuracy. This study proposes a hybrid model that combines deep learning, machine learning, and traditional image processing techniques to detect brain tumors from MRI images. The proposed model is based on a convolutional neural network (CNN) algorithm and a machine learning model. The first stage is employing the histogram equalisation approach to enhance the image. In the second stage, features of the grey level co-occurrence matrix are extracted from the improved image. Convolutional neural networks are utilised in the third stage to categorise as normal or abnormal. The abnormal brain tumor is segmented using a morphological segmentation algorithm. This study suggests a number of performance criteria, such as accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity, to evaluate the efficacy of the proposeed method. Our proposes algorithm demonstrates superior performance compared to existing methods regarding accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity.

articleTitle: SignXchange System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: An extensive communication hole among speech and hearing impaired people and different people exists, and it's crucial that this hole be closed. The accuracy of hardware gloves which use sensors are very low. The present records uses convolutional neural network models to increase the accuracy. The scope was limited and the data sets were not diverse, thus a new diversified data set was made and the model was further enhanced. The new model can anticipate practically every letter with a very high degree of accuracy. We expanded our data set with a number of additional gestures that included various hand gestures. This model has enormous promise since, given the right data, it can decipher every gesture used in a variety of sign languages. The data-set can be further customized by the user by adding other motions. Additionally, the information is delivered to a program that will turn the received hand gesture into text. The technology is bidirectional, meaning that text may also be translated into sign language, in order to close the communication gap. First the hand gesture is given as the input and transformed to text, response of the other user for that is given as text and it is taken directly as the input and translated to the appropriate gesture in accordance with the practical sign language.

articleTitle: A Tool for Database Masking and Anonymization of PostgreSQL
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Managing and securing sensitive data in a production database can be a complex and challenging task, especially when creating a staging database for testing and development purposes. This is why we have designed a tool that can automate the process of creating a staging database from a backup of the production database while anonymizing critical data based on user input. Our tool is specifically designed for PostgreSQL databases and can be easily integrated into the database management workflow. It allows users to select which tables and fields in the database should be anonymized, with options for different anonymization techniques based on the data type. This ensures that sensitive data is properly protected and complies with data privacy regulations. To ensure the success of the anonymization process, the tool utilizes machine learning algorithms that analyze past user input to predict which fields are likely to be selected for anonymization. This helps reduce the risk of errors and ensures that all critical data is properly anonymized with high accuracy. In the future, we plan to enhance the tool with more advanced anonymization techniques and incorporate additional machine-learning algorithms to improve the accuracy of the prediction models. This will help further streamline the database management process and ensure that sensitive data is always properly secured.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Prediction of Underwater Wireless Communication using Machine Learning Techniques and Related Issues
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This research aims to enhance the prediction of underwater wireless communication for underwater wireless sensor networks using Logistic Regression compared with Linear Regression Algorithms. To forecast the functionality of underwater wireless sensor networks Linear Regression and Novel Logistic Regression algorithms were used with different training and testing splits with Underwater Acoustic Wireless Sensor. A sample size of 20 (Each 10 from Group 1 and Group 2) is calculated by fixing a G-power of 0.8, alpha and beta values of 0.05 and 0.2, and a confidence interval of 95%. With a statistical significance value of 0.001 (p<0.05), Novel Logistic Regression (87.77% & 12.22%) outperforms Linear Regression (80.17% & 19.32%) in terms of accuracy and Loss which is statistically significant. The Underwater Wireless Communication efficiency were compared with the obtained results for Linear Regression, Logistic Regression proves to have higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Medium-Term Electric Demand Prediction using Whale Optimisation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In the electric sector, predicting electric demand is crucial since it serves as the foundation for decision-making about the design and operation of the power sector. This study intends to predict the electric demand for India based on different economic indicators, such as Populace, per capita Gross domestic product (per capita GDP), and per capita Gross Domestic Income (per capita GDI). Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) has been adopted for study for better optimal results. Electric demand has been predicted as medium-term planning. For this study, India as a study system that has been adopted. WOA_Electric demand (WOA_ED) models have been made for the prediction of electric demand till 2026. Proposed models have been developed on linear and non-linear equations to improve the prediction accuracy. MAPE (Mean Absolute Percentage Error) is best suited for the models to evaluate and estimate the electric demand. Based on different economic indicators and results, the electric demand is estimated until 2026.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Search with Multi-Keyword Security and Improved Service Quality
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Over the past ten years, there has been a tremendous advancement in machine learning and computer vision, which has led to a large decrease in computing complexity and an increase in efficiency for visual learning algorithms. The Automated Question and Answering System combines stemming with a partial match retrieval technique to do this. The answer provided by the suggested method will be improved over the standard text answer provided by the visual learning system by using text and multimedia, like an image or video. Based on the classifiers for all the predefined qualities, an attribute feature, including the answers from these classifiers, represents each image. The proposed uses a novel picture re-ranking architecture that learns different semantic spaces for different query phrases. The features of the photographs are projected. Images are reranked online by comparing their semantic signatures, retrieved from the semantic space the query term specifies. The suggested semantic fingerprints specific to a query greatly increase the precision and effectiveness of image reranking. Our project primarily focuses on making retrieving data from the internet simple to boost productivity and shorten the time it takes a user to look for the necessary query. Our software uses an application programming interface or API to locate the specific term the user seeks in the WordNet database. A stemming algorithm is used to modify the query multiple times until the right match is identified in the database. Utilizing Levenshtein distance, The classified data is entered into the relevant columns. Consequently, the user can examine the three columns separately and find his needs in that specific speech context. The main advantage of this type of searching is that everything is available in the API we use; therefore, no data set is required.

articleTitle: Cartoon Face Detection and Recognition with Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In the past few years, we have witnessed a high attentiveness in cartoon media, power-driven by the strong demands of the industry. The first step to understanding this media, cartoon face recognition and detection is a very important but less explored work with fewer datasets proposed. The paper, we have proposed has two methods for face recognition and face detection for different cartoon characters that appear in comics, cartoons, games, etc. Cartoon face recognition and detection is a more difficult and challenging task than human face detection because of the many difficult scenes involved. If we aim at the characteristics of cartoon faces, huge differences within the intra-faces exist. In order to identify the emotions from cartoon images, we have employed a Deep Neural Network (DNN) approach in this paper. Two cartoon characters, “Tom” and “Jerry,” who each exhibit diverse emotions like surprise, happiness, sadness, and rage, were used to create the dataset. The DNN method that successfully distinguishes cartoon characters splits their face masks and names the ensuing emotions with an accuracy score.

articleTitle: Intelligent Machine Fault Detection in Industries using Supervised Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In the modern epoch of Industry 4.0, Artificial Intelligence (AI) has made huge industry performances to shape our daily lives, increase production efficiency, and reduce economic losses. Predictive maintenance identifies the equipment faults earlier and reduces unexpected failures and sudden machine shutdowns. IoT sensors are fitted with the machinery parts, and the data gathered from the IoT sensors detect the misbehavior or faults in the machine. In this paper, three machine learning algorithms are applied for feature selection and prediction of faults in the machine. In the first stage, features from the machine were selected using the logistic regression method. From the selected features, the faults are classified with Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naïve Bayes, and Decision Tree classifier. The performance of the algorithms was evaluated with precision, recall, and accuracy. The results show that the supervised machine learning methods work well in predicting faults in machine parts.

articleTitle: Deep-Q-Based Reinforcement Learning Method to Predict Accuracy of Atari Gaming Set Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: A pivotal acquisition model designed to formulate control strategies directly from high-level perceptual data using reinforcement learning is introduced by us. The training of this model, a convolutional neural network, was done using a different Q-learning algorithm. An output is produced in the form of a value function that indicates anticipated future earnings after processing raw image inputs. Recent demonstrations of cutting-edge performance in reinforcement learning tasks have been made by these neural networks, which leverage Deep Q-Networks (DQNs) based on the Q-Learning algorithm. The planning process for DQNs is significantly different from that of standard deep neural networks, resulting in significant challenges in specific reinforcement learning scenarios.

articleTitle: Early-Stage Detection of Cancer Cells Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Cancer is an inflectional illness in which certain body cells become uncontrollably enormous and invade other bodily regions. Machine learning (ML) methodologies for classifying those with cancer into extremely dangerous or relatively low-risk categories have been investigated by multiple teams of investigators from both the biomedical and bioinformatics sectors. Given the number of deaths brought on by different cancers, it is thought to be a severe threat, but as a result of advances in medical research today, such a threat can be eliminated if discovered in its earliest stages without harming the patient. The main difficulty is identifying the patient's cancer type— whether it is benign or malignant—and making the appropriate diagnosis. By producing findings with high precision and accuracy, machine learning methods like K Nearest Neighbors (KNN) with Support Vector Machine (SVM) aid in the solution of this issue. Using KNN and SVM, this paper describes and illustrates how to identify cancer. An accurate comparison with previous studies is also made. We achieved reliability using K-Nearest Neighbors was 0.93586 for the F1 Score and 0.88008 for Jaccard Score, respectively. Using the Support Vector Machine, it was 0.94311 for the F1 Score and 0.89281 for Jaccard Score.

articleTitle: Hyperpersonalization of Educational Content Through Multimodal Deep Learning and Gamification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This project proposes a groundbreaking approach to revolutionize the traditional educational framework by integrating multimodal deep learning and gamification to foster hyper-personalized learning experiences. Envisioning a classroom where education resonates with individual cognitive rhythms and passions, the system employs advanced algorithms to analyze text, voice, and facial expressions, thereby adapting content delivery to cater to diverse learning styles and needs. Concurrently, gamified elements such as points, badges, and personalized challenges enhance motivation, engagement, and retention. The teacher’s role transforms from a primary knowledge source to a skilled guide and facilitator, leveraging AI-driven insights to curate tailored learning experiences and interventions. This paradigm shift in pedagogy aims to create an inclusive, empowering, and adaptive learning environment where every student embarks on a personalized educational odyssey, celebrating their unique potential and fostering lifelong learning.

articleTitle: Design and Management of an Intelligent Parking Slot System using Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Our nation has been rapidly developing for decades, with many business buildings, well-maintained highways, and increasing vehicles. The transportation sector’s extensive use in trade and commerce has also become the economy’s foundation. Parking automobiles has, therefore, become an issue. Parking availability is a major problem in some areas, particularly retail centers, hospitals, and other structures that need much room to park cars. The established methods of placing sensors for parking cars grow expensive. As a result, an effective strategy that lasts a long period is needed to handle the congestion problem. This project aims to provide an IoT framework for smart vehicle parking. The method that has been created yields consistent results when parking effectiveness and search time parameters are used.

articleTitle: Twitter Sentiment Analysis and Prediction using NLP
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Social media has emerged as a pivotal platform for individuals to convey their thoughts and emotions, making it imperative for businesses, governments, and organizations to leverage artificial intelligence, such as sentiment analysis. This tool allows them to gauge public reactions on social media, particularly in the context of significant events like lockdown announcements. Employing relevant hashtags on Twitter, we aim to conduct sentiment analysis on how Indians are responding to these announcements and construct a predictive analytics model to discern people’s behaviour. The developed model incorporates the nuances of modern internet slang to capture and interpret user sentiments accurately. This technology not only facilitates an in-depth understanding of public sentiment but also offers a visually intuitive representation for easy comprehension. The applications of this solution are broad, benefiting organizations, businesses, and governments in various scenarios.The methodology involves the collection of tweets using Twitter’s provided services, followed by the storage of this data in our database. Subsequent processing focuses on extracting meaningful and pertinent elements from the text to facilitate a comprehensive analysis.

articleTitle: Explaining Autism Diagnosis Model Through Local Interpretability Techniques – A Post-hoc Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In this era of machine learning and deep learning algorithms dominating the Artificial Intelligence (AI) world, the trustworthiness of these black box models is still questionable. Life-caring sectors like healthcare and banking make use of these black box models as assistance in critical decision-making processes, but the degree of reliability of these decisions is still uncertain. This is because these black box models will not reveal the causation of the predicted outcome. However, creating an interpretable model that can explain the internal workings of these black box models can provide some reliable insights and trustable justifications for the predicted outcome. This study aimed to create an interpretable model for autism diagnosis which can give some trustable explanations for its predicted outcome. Using local interpretability methods such as LIME, SHAP, and Anchors the predicted outcome for each instance is explained well with some standard visual representations. As a result, this study developed an interpretable autism diagnosis model with an accuracy rate of 91.37% and with good local model explanations.

articleTitle: Transforming Healthcare with MedInsight: A Guide to Intelligent Decision Support
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: A novel Prediction System has been developed to address the lack of a unified approach for multi-disease prediction in healthcare machine learning models. The To detect various ailments, the system uses machine learning neural network as well as artificial intelligence. simultaneously, specifically targeting heart, liver, and diabetes conditions. The system uses Support Vector Machine and logistic regression models to analyze heart disorders, diabetes, and breast cancer. The logistic regression model, trained on 8,000 patients, achieved an impressive overall accuracy of 85%. It was particularly effective in predicting hypertension and hyperlipidaemia, with accuracies of 90% and 87%, respectively. The system also showed proficiency in predicting diabetes and heart disease, with accuracies of 82% and 78%. This research represents a promising step towards a more comprehensive and accurate multi-disease prediction system.

articleTitle: Satellite Image-Based Wildfire Detection and Alerting System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Wildfires are an unavoidable component of the ecology of Earth. They are necessary for the health of the forest environment. Wildfires, on the other hand, are one of the most damaging natural disasters in the world. They contribute to global warming, ruin property, cause major economic losses, and finally kill humans and animals. Previously, artificial intelligence had a key role in wildfire management, according to the study. This paper describes a machine-learning technique for accurately identifying wildfires in real-time. This system has been trained to validate and input photographs of wildfires at all times of day and night. This is linked to existing forest response systems via APIs for waking, resulting in a real-time automatic wildfire detection system. The findings of this study can be expanded by fine-tuning the network to construct wildfire detection systems for diverse geographies and places.

articleTitle: Rash Driver Identification System Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Road injuries have been growing every day. Around 8 lakh street injuries occur every 12 months in India on my own. In 2022, it's been mentioned that 4,61,321 avenue accidents were stated and 1,68,491 humans have misplaced their life, i.e., in a mean, 1,263 accidents and 461 deaths each day and nearly 52 injuries and 19 deaths each hour.
