The fundamental purpose for many of those accidents is rash use, and people are at exquisite risk of controlling rash driving. The proposed solution is to create a tool to manipulate the automobile's velocity based totally on diverse sign boards in the avenue facet. Nowadays, most automobiles are geared up with opposite digicams to get the vehicle's rearview and the front camera to permit the driving force to identify the precise pairing role. The front digital camera inside the cars can be related to the real-time circuit that tracks the sign forums at the road facet. If the vehicle's speed is higher than the authorized variety or if the driving force violates any of the signal boards, he could be warned, and simultaneously, the car's speed will be reduced. Computer imaginative and prescient neural networks and Machine Learning algorithms detect diverse sign forums in the avenue. If the driver violates the rule for the second time, an alert will be dispatched to the nearby visitor's police at the side of the automobile info. By controlling the automobile's velocity, rash driving can be decreased accordingly, and accidents can be averted.

articleTitle: Improving the Rate of Facial Emotion Recognition using CNN Based Attention Capsule Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Developing the emotional perception of computers is a technological trend. Emotion recognition composes cognitive systems with applicability in several areas. Facial expression is an effective way to recognize emotions, mainly because it is less intrusive in data collection when compared to other methods, and because of the ease of obtaining images of the face in view of the popularization of cameras. Through facial expressions it is possible to classify the group of basic emotions. Currently, convolution neural networks (CNN) have been the state of the art for image classification. Given this context, this work presents an approach to recognize emotions by facial expression using CNN based on attention capsule networks. On imaging datasets, the majority of conventional techniques work admirably. However, more on difficult data with more image variance and incomplete faces, they do not function along with they do in controlled conditions. It is found that, the attention capsule networks algorithm can achieve satisfactory classification result, and that it can serve as a useful empirical model for development on users’ emotion identification and graphical representation of emotions in intelligence learning.

Author Keywords: Spatial and Temporal Feature Extraction and Image Enhancement

articleTitle: Utilization of Different Machine Learning Techniques on Anti-cancer Plant Leaves Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Cancer a leading cause of death globally, now demanding new therapies and methodologies which give efficient therapeutic effect with minimal side effects. Kingdom plantae is rich source, as is abundant with members of great significant use. On going research on plant driven therapies Particularly “leaves “of few plants are proved by experimentations to be enriched with constituents which proves to be a great remedy to pathologies like cancer. The review serves an overview of anti-cancerous property identified by multiple researchers on the leave extracts of plants such as – Mint, Neem, Oleander, Parijat and Peepal. Ethyl extract of Mentha piperita (Mint)leaves shows inhibitory effect on cancer cell lines. Apoptosis is found to be induced by leafy extract of Azadirachta indica (Neem). Water leaf extract of Nerium oleander (Oleander) was clinically found to hamper lung cancer activity. The methanolic extract of Nyctanthes arbortristis (Parijat) inhibit cancer cell lines.The leaves ethanolic extract of Ficus religiosa (Peepal) inhibit adenocarcinoma. ResNet50 Feature extractor was used for Random Forest, Adaboost, XG Boost, and classification tree algorithms. Using Random Forest and Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), the highest accuracy of 98.4% with ResNet50 feature extractor was achieved.

articleTitle: Exposure on Semi-Supervised Regression with Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Semi-supervised learning presents a challenge in preparing a classifier in a dataset that has few marked and many unlabelled models. The GAN architecture is expanded by the semi-supervised GAN model, which involves preparing a managed discriminator, an unaided discriminator, and a generator model simultaneously. The result is a managed grouping model that effectively sums up hidden models and a generator model that produces possible instances of pictures from the domain. The aim of research is to study semi-supervised learning problems using GANs for regression. The goal of reverse engineering is to predict the continuum of data given rather than simply splitting the work into a small number of different categories. In the case of autonomous driving, for example, it is very expensive to obtain a sufficient number of written standards covering all driving. In this particular case, we can use the semi-supervised learning method together with the basic structure design, such as the creation of negative networks. The proposed GAN-based semi-supervised writing strategies are centered around addressing the characterization issue. The problem of developing a semi-supervised method using GAN for regression tasks is still unresolved. Reg-GAN has been presented in two different architectures to address this issue.

articleTitle: Classification of Chest X-Ray Images using Various Deep Learning Techniques to Identify Covid-19
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The healthcare community is deeply concerned about the novel coronavirus (2019-nCoV) that is spreading throughout the world. Since its discovery in late December 2019, the number of cases transferred from Wuhan, China to other countries has increased, causing ongoing changes in the medical environment. With the rapid surge of confirmed cases worldwide, initial focus centered on a Wuhan food market as the outbreak's source. However, a recent overview of primary clinical cases published in The Lancet challenges this hypothesis. Among the diverse strategies employed to curb the virus, closely monitoring its progression through international genomic sequencing has emerged as a crucial measure. Controlling the virus's spread stands as an immensely challenging task, underscoring the necessity for highly accurate health surveillance to enable prompt responses.

articleTitle: Cognitive Computing for Wheat Leaf Disease Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Precision agriculture relies on crop disease detection to boost production and food security. This paper introduces Cognitive Computing-based wheat leaf disease detection. The approach uses machine learning, natural language processing, and interpretability to identify diseases accurately and easily. The results demonstrate the advantage of cognitive computing over traditional methods. In comparison to CNNs and SVMs, our model had superior accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 scores. The model’s strong performance metrics across folds were confirmed by cross-validation. The Cognitive Computing model was faster than CNNs and SVMs in inference, making it appropriate for real-time illness identification. Interpretability was examined by showing how the model’s decision-making process may be presented in normal language to build user trust. These findings show that Cognitive Computing can revolutionize wheat leaf disease diagnosis, providing farmers and agriculture stakeholders with a realistic and effective solution. The work advances precision agriculture by showing how modern technologies may solve difficult crop health monitoring problems.

articleTitle: Comparative Web Product Analysis: A Data-Driven Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This research endeavor seeks to streamline the intricacies of product discovery and analysis, empowering users to locate their desired products efficiently. Our approach involves indepth analysis encompassing pricing, market insights, sentiment analysis, historical trends, and real-time product comparisons. Leveraging advanced data scraping and data science techniques, we aim to deliver valuable insights from an extensive data pool, facilitating informed decision-making. The implications of this work extend across business, personal, and commercial domains, allowing users to make informed choices based on factors such as product availability, pricing, and specific requirements. Achieving this objective necessitates advanced data abstraction, cleansing, and optimization methods underpinned by a robust architectural framework. Moreover, we introduce a product analysis page for visual data representation, optimizing search and retrieval techniques. Empirical evaluations highlight the efficiency and accuracy of our machine learning classifiers, with a primary focus on handling unstructured and heterogeneous product data sourced from the web and various e-commerce platforms.

articleTitle: Optimizing Plant Health Monitoring: A CNN Model Based Rice and Cotton Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Rice and cotton are crucial cash crops in India that contribute significantly to the country’s economy and provide employment to millions of people. To ensure high crop yields, it is essential to effectively manage crop diseases. However, traditional monitoring methods relying on human observation can be time consuming and inefficient. Hence, a system that can accurately and effectively detect plant diseases at the beginning is needed. In this paper, we present our study into the training and evaluation of different CNN models using a shared dataset that focuses on five diseases, including blast, bacterial leaf blight, brown spot, and diseased or healthy cotton leaf in cotton plants. The ResNet, VGG19, and Inception models obtained accuracy percentages of 63%, 66%, and 89%, respectively. On the same dataset, the general CNN architecture model had a 95% accuracy rate. Our findings suggest that the basic CNN architecture can be used effectively to predict diseases in rice and cotton plants. The general CNN model outperformed the ResNet and Inception models, indicating that a simpler architecture can yield better results for this specific task. In the context of Indian agriculture, this work offers important insights for the creation of a precise and effective system for the early diagnosis of plant illnesses. Finally, based on the input given to the model the disease is predicted and a cure for that predicted disease is given both in organic and chemical methods.

articleTitle: Elevating Movie Reviews with Intelligent Recommendation Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The Substance-Based Film Proposal and Survey Framework utilizing Feeling Investigation with the TMDB Data set is a product framework that gives film suggestions to clients in view of the substance of the motion pictures and the opinion of the film audits. The framework utilizes the data set and TMDB Programming interface, which contains a huge measure of data about films, to gather film information and dissect the opinion of the film surveys. Present-day public activities require the utilization of film suggestion frameworks since they advance media outlets. The client’s requirements are met by the proposed framework for film suggestions. The fundamental objective of Film Genie is to convey end clients with compact, relevant substance from the web’s semi-organized content. The essential objective is to give the client exact, powerful, and individualized proposals. There is a broad conversation of the paper’s different parts, including the presentation, writing audit, proposed framework, execution and results, near investigation, end, and future work. A nostalgic classifier that recognizes positive and negative opinions is made utilizing NLTK and a cosine comparability AI calculation to prepare and assess the model. The mix with the TMDB Programming interface keys guarantees that the framework approaches the most state-of-the-art film information, giving clients the most pertinent film suggestions. This application is likewise coordinated with the chatbot utilizing Watson Collaborator to upgrade the exhibition of the clients and let them know more about the application.

Author Keywords: content-based movie recommendation and review system

articleTitle: Evaluating Effectiveness of AI-Driven Virtual Assistants in Enhancing Productivity and Well-Being in the Workspace
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper presents a novel software application designed to serve as a virtual assistant for PC users. The application is built by fine-tuning the GPT-3 model and using Python modules to execute operations. It possesses the ability to execute a range of functions, such as handling files, managing directories, and overseeing memory operations. The application also includes a recommendation system that provides action requirements to users, thereby enhancing its utility and user experience. The paper discusses the design and implementation of the application, highlighting its key features and functionalities. It also presents the results of user testing, demonstrating the application's effectiveness and potential for future development.

articleTitle: Decision-Making for Electric Vehicle Selection Using AHP-MABAC-Fuzzy Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The widespread adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) is pivotal for achieving sustainable and eco-friendly transportation systems. However, the selection of an optimal electric vehicle considering multiple criteria poses a complex decision-making challenge. This research proposes an integrated approach that combines the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), Multi-Attributive Border Approximation Area Comparison (MABAC), and Fuzzy Logic to enhance the decision-making process for selecting the most suitable electric vehicle. The AHP is employed to structure the hierarchy of criteria and sub-criteria, capturing the diverse factors influencing EV selection, including cost, range, charging infrastructure, environmental impact, and performance. MABAC, a multi-criteria decision-making method, is utilized to calculate the relative rankings and weights of alternatives based on pairwise comparisons, considering both positive and negative aspects.To account for the inherent uncertainties and vagueness in decision-making, fuzzy logic is integrated to handle linguistic assessments and subjective judgments. Fuzzy sets and membership functions are employed to model the imprecision in decision-makers preferences, providing a more realistic representation of the decision-making process. The proposed AHP-MABAC-Fuzzy integration is applied to a case study involving the selection of electric vehicles, considering a set of real-world criteria and sub-criteria. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the integrated approach in handling the complexity and uncertainty associated with electric vehicle selection. This research contributes to the field of multi-criteria decision-making for sustainable transportation by providing a comprehensive and flexible methodology for electric vehicle selection. The integration of AHP, MABAC, and fuzzy logic offers a robust framework that can be adapted for decision-making in various domains where multiple conflicting criteria need to be considered.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Diabetic Retinopathy: Gaussian SVM Model for Accurate Analysis in Retinal Fundus Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The most common ocular ailment in people with diabetes that causes vision loss in this population is diabetic retinopathy. Patients are protected from vision loss by diabetic retinopathy. The findings of this study point to the need for an early diagnosis system that can help the physician in analyzing retinal images. The main goal is to classify severity level from any given retinal images automatically. To accomplish this, an initial image processing phase is utilized to distinguish and isolate blood vessels, micro-aneurysms, and hard exudates. This process enables the retrieval of particular attributes that can be applied by a support vector machine in order to ascertain the severity of retinopathy for every retinal image. The efficacy of this idea has been evaluated using a database consisting of 300 retinal images that have been categorized based on the severity of diabetic retinopathy. The outcome yielded a maximum sensitivity of 95.95% and an accuracy of 92.66%. An assessment of the algorithm’s resilience to variations in its parameters has also been conducted. The suggested framework will enhance the efficiency and accuracy of disease detection compared to existing frameworks

articleTitle: Virtual Mouse using Hand and Eye Gestures
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Human hands and eyes have a wealth of information that may be accessed and applied in a variety of ways In this study, a brand-new technique for using a live camera to control mouse movement is introduced. We illustrate how it can perform all activities that current mouse devices can by using a camera and computer vision technology, which is the basis behind our approach to managing mouse duties. In addition to focusing on a human-computer interaction application based on eye and hand tracking, this research aims to propose a low-cost, real-time system for tracking mouse eye and hand motions. Additionally, these motions may be recorded and utilized as control signals to let users interact with interfaces without needing a mouse or keyboard. Algorithms for computer vision and image processing can be used to accomplish this. This model operates the system using hand gestures or eye gestures in the graphical user interface.

articleTitle: Efficient Detection of Missing and Misplaced Components in Electronic Boards through Edge Impulse’s Automated Inspection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The detection of missing and misplaced components on electronic boards is a critical and important task in the quality assurance process of electronic manufacturing. Traditional manual inspection methods are prone to human errors and are time consuming. In this work, we proposed an automated approach using Edge Impulse’s transfer learning technique. We trained a neural network model MobileNetV2 using transfer learning and evaluated the model’s performance on a test set. The results show that our trained model have achieved an accuracy of 94.2% validation set of trained data set and 96.55% misplaced components. We trained our model with twelve possible cases of errors and demonstrate the practical applicability of our approach by deploying the model on a Raspberry Pi 4 using Edge Impulse’s deployment tools. Furthermore, the use of Edge Impulse’s transfer learning and deployment tools makes our approach cost-effective, scalable, and easy to implement in real-world manufacturing environments.

articleTitle: Sign Language to Text Conversion using RNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The speech-impaired community only uses sign language; the rest of society interacts verbally. Our research intends to fill this communication gap by proposing a state-of-the-art method for comprehending both static and moving signs in Indian Sign Language and translating them into text. Data is collected, pre-processed, and hand recognition is finished using media pipe holistic before being categorized into suitable speech output. Because LSTM networks can develop long-term dependencies, they were investigated and employed for the classification of gesture data. The constructed model exhibited a 100% accuracy rate while categorizing 26 motions, highlighting the usefulness of LSTM-based neural networks for sign language translation. For those who are deaf or dumb, translating sign language into text allows them to interact with each other or with people in the general public by using hand gestures. According to a survey we conducted on sign language comprehension, most people are unable to identify the hand gestures and mode of communication used by sign language users. After hearing about all the difficulties, they have communicating with regular people, we developed this initiative on sign language transcription. The community of deaf and mute people will benefit from this initiative because it explains the meaning of each hand gesture and uses hand gestures to communicate various signs. In this project, hand gestures were recognized using a pipeline method called media pipe, and training and testing were carried out using deep learning techniques. Sign language was then converted to text format.

articleTitle: Applying Deep Learning and Transfer Learning Techniques for Improving Animal Intrusion Detection in Agriculture Farms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Due to the nature of farmlands or provincial landscapes, monitoring is required to keep unauthorized persons out of the region and to safeguard the district from wildlife. Various techniques point straight towards perception, which is primarily for human gatecrashers, but we sometimes forget that the primary opponents of such farmers are the animals who trash the crops. Crop damage caused by monster attacks is one of the most serious dangers to collect yield. Crop striking is becoming one of the most distant human-natural life conflicts as created land expands into formerly untamed life domain. The principle is compelling and forceful checking of the wild creatures’ squarely at home. This research paper is focused to develop computational techniques for identifying the animals that swoop into the agricultural area. Because there are so many various kinds of organisms, genuinely recognizing them may be a difficult task. In this paper, we have used a camera to capture routine images of the surrounding area and to observe the entire homestead at regular intervals. With the aid of further developed learning models, we can distinguish between different stages of a creature’s development and play appropriate noises to frighten them off. The various convolutional brain network libraries and ideas that went into creating the model are acknowledged in this study. We have worked on the path of creature interruption discovery in agribusiness areas using deep learning and move learning techniques.

articleTitle: Prediction of Flank Wear in Turning of Monel K500 by Using Machine Learning Model in Comparison With Experimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This study uses machine learning algorithms to estimate flank wear in Monel K500, a high-performance nickel-copper alloy, turning. Experimental findings are compared. Tool life, machining quality, and process efficiency depend on flank wear. Traditional flank wear predictions use empirical models based on experimental data, which may be inaccurate and unreliable. This work investigates an alternate flank wear prediction method utilizing machine learning algorithms. Support vector machines, random forests, and neural networks are used to create prediction models using cutting parameters, tool attributes, and workpiece qualities. Experimental data from Monel K500 turning experiments trains and validates the models. Machine learning models are tested against experimental analysis findings to determine accuracy and dependability. The study evaluates machine learning’s flank wear prediction accuracy and finds the best model for Monel K500 turning operations. The models’ study also reveals Monel K500 machining flank wear variables. This research improves flank wear prediction in Monel K500 turning operations and sheds light on machine learning in machining optimization. The findings can help manufacturers and researchers improve Monel K500 and comparable alloy machining techniques, reduce tool wear, and boost productivity.

articleTitle: Hybrid System with Modified Cuckoo Search to Design Airfoil
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The proposed models can design the airfoil by Cuckoo search with Levenberg-Marquardt. The Neural Network framework has impediments due to over-fitting. This paper proposed a modified cuckoo search. here the aerodynamic coefficient as an input to produce output the airfoil coordinates. The generated airfoil is compared to know its performance metrics. The Cuckoo search with the Feedforward Neural Network model yields the lowest prediction error.

articleTitle: Development of Tendon-Driven Robot Leg Displaying Gait Motion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In recent years, legged robots have gained significant attention in the field of robotics due to their potential applications in industries such as search and rescue, last-mile delivery, and military operations. These robots excel at navigating challenging terrains where their wheeled counterparts face limitations. Achieving efficient and smooth movement is a crucial aspect for legged robots, with locomotion types like hopping and trotting playing a vital role. Precise control of leg joints is essential to ensure stable and efficient motion. This paper presents a lightweight robot leg prototype with two degrees of freedom that accurately mimics animal leg movement during hopping and trotting. Experimental testing was conducted in lab using a specially designed test rig, which would evaluate the prototype’s performance across different ground conditions, facilitating design and control optimization. The modularity of the robot leg prototype allows for easy component replacement and modification. The paper also emphasizes the significance of a robust control system capable of adapting to diverse terrains and effectively handling unexpected disturbances. The paper concludes with the design of the leg prototype with sufficient sensors on board and the test rig for the leg prototype in order to test the control algorithms.

articleTitle: Calorie Recognition from Food Images Using CNN for Nutritional Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In recent years, people tend to consume excess junk food and are unaware of the calories taken. To have a healthy diet, you need to calculate your calorie count before eating. We have developed a calorie management system using deep learning algorithms from images provided by users to enable users to track their daily calorie intake. It can be used for daily calorie tracking for health enthusiasts. It can also provide information about food ingredients. This project uses the Gray Level Co- occurrence Matrix and the Discrete Wavelet Transform.

articleTitle: Optimizing Visual Clarity: A Data-DrivenAnalysis of Foggy and Sunny Image Enhancement with LeNet Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In images taken during hazy or foggy weather conditions, the movement of atmospheric particles can obscure details, reduce contrast, alter colors, and make it challenging for both human vision and certain outdoor computer vision devices to identify objects. While vehicle safety has been improving over the years, some mass-market and fleet cars in India still require structural enhancements to adapt to changing environmental conditions. Foggy weather presents significant challenges for drivers, as it severely limits visibility, impairs hazard detection, and makes it hard to judge distances. To address this issue, many vehicles are equipped with cameras that capture the view ahead. However, in both foggy and sunny weather conditions, the images captured by these cameras may lack clarity. Therefore, the field of image dehazing has garnered significant attention in computer vision. Image dehazing is a technique used to remove the negative impact of weather conditions on images, improving their visual quality through post-processing. This research work focuses on improving and enhancing images captured during both foggy and sunny weather conditions. The proposed method utilizes grayscale images as input signals and operates in real-time. It employs a straightforward linear classifier that achieves high detection rates in both daytime and nighttime scenes.

articleTitle: Outdoor Obstacle Detection Module to Assist Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The objective of this initiative is to overcome the constraints of current technology used by individuals with vision impairment to improve their autonomous navigation. Current technology such as walking sticks have limitations that inhibit individuals from participating from various activities. To address these restrictions, a hands-free module has been designed. The module enables identification of dynamic objects in outdoor and indoor environments. A Raspberry pi board, a Raspberry pi camera module, a buzzer and ultrasound sensors are some of the components used in this solution. Object detection is being done with the real-time video captured using the camera and the object detection model used has been deployed using TensorFlow Lite. The ultrasonic module simultaneously examines the user’s surroundings in three directions to detect obstacles. The distance between the user and obstacle is calculated with the data obtained from the Ultrasonic sensors. When an obstacle is detected, the user is immediately alerted via the audio output through headphones. This enables them to react to their surroundings swiftly. All of these separate modules are combined onto a belt for convenience and durability which gives a hands-free option to those who need it.

articleTitle: Machine Learning - Based Prediction of Compressive Strength Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This study’s main goal is to assess concrete’s compressive strength using the soft computing technique in a way that uses less time, money, and material resources. Using machine learning (ML) in the creation of concrete mixes is expanding swiftly because of its revolutionary potential and ability to address difficult challenges. To forecast the water absorption and compressive strength of concrete at 28 days of age, a comparative study was carried out utilizing the “JUPITER” software environment and the ML method Artificial Neural Network (ANN). The dataset was produced in a controlled laboratory setting. It is demonstrated that the suggested ANN model predicts the compressive strength of concrete ratio with a high degree of accuracy using the coefficient of determination (R2) and root-mean-square error (RMSE) for validation.

articleTitle: Mapping Severe Tropical Cyclone Tauktae Across the Arabian Sea and Western Coast of India Using Remote Sensing and Machine Learning During May 2021
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In May 2021, the Arabian Sea experienced the formation of a tropical supercyclone, "Tauktae," which resulted in extensive destruction throughout the coastline regions of Mumbai, Goa, and Gujarat. The cyclone initiated from a low-pressure system situated over the Bay of Bengal, progressively strengthening into the cyclonic storm named "Tauktae" and subsequently moving along the western coast of India. The objective of this study is to analyze the characteristics of cyclones by utilizing higher rainfall estimations obtained from the Meteosat-8 satellite. The analysis of Meteosat-8 observations was conducted utilizing machine learning (ML) techniques. During the cyclone, there were notable quantities of precipitation that surpassed 600mm per day. The diurnal changes exhibited pronounced levels of precipitation, with rainfall rates reaching 50-60mm/hr in regions badly impacted by the cyclone, namely Gujarat, Mumbai, and Goa. The study area encountered a substantial precipitation event on May 20, 2021, with an estimated rainfall accumulation of around 650mm. The cyclone “Tauktae" exhibited a northwestward trajectory with a velocity of 16 kilometers per hour across the Arabian Sea. Its point of origin was located at a latitude of $16.2^{\circ}\mathrm{N}$ and a longitude of $72.6^{\circ}\mathrm{E}$, precisely around 1430 Indian Standard Time (IST).The region of Goa saw significant consequences of Cyclone Tauktae, which manifested in the form of powerful winds, elevated sea levels, and heavy precipitation. Moreover, the occurrence of heavy rainstorms on May 20th resulted in significant cumulative precipitation, which subsequently caused landslides and catastrophic flash flooding in multiple regions along India's western coastline. The current investigation highlights the significance of employing high-resolution satellite data and machine learning techniques for real-time mapping and monitoring of atmospheric parameters. This approach is crucial for the successful implementation of catastrophe mitigation methods. Through the utilization of cutting-edge satellite technology and the meticulous analysis of up-to-the-minute data, policymakers and authorities responsible for disaster management can acquire invaluable knowledge pertaining to the characteristics and severity of cyclonic occurrences such as Tauktae. This understanding is crucial for developing effective ways to lessen the impact of such disasters and protect vulnerable coastal populations. This study highlights the importance of obtaining timely and precise information through the use of high-resolution satellite observations in the context of disaster management and preparedness.

articleTitle: IoT and Cloud-Based Smart Farming with Optimized Convolutional Neural Networks for Grape Fruit Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The importance of agriculture as a component of India’s economy is well-known. Also, most people agree that a big segment of the population relies on agriculture as a source of income. More over 60% of the population is connected to agriculture in some way, shape, or form. More recently, technological advancements have allowed for the application of IoTtechnology in agriculture, which has increased production while decreasing resource waste. This paper presents a novel model for Smart Farming that leverages the IoT technology. The model incorporates an enhanced crow search (ECS) algorithm to effectively optimise parameters for a multilevel feature selection algorithm. The ECS-CNN technique is a feature selection algorithm that has been specifically developed for the purpose of enhancing the performance of a convolutional neural network (CNN) classifier. The methodology proposed entails the initial acquisition of plant images using IoT devices, which are subsequently stored in a cloud-based system. The ECS-CNN model, which has been proposed, is deployed on a cloud platform for the purpose of detecting and categorising instances of plant diseases. The present study employs a benchmark dataset known as the Grape Image Gallery dataset for the purpose of conducting experiments.

articleTitle: Development of an Efficient CNN model with Hyperparameter tuning for Early Prediction of Lung Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Deep learning (DL), an evolving technology, allows computers to learn autonomously from historical data. Furthermore, it employs a number of methodologies to generate the precise models and create predictions based on facts or old data. A deep learning system produces the predictions based on mathematical models of prediction which is built from past information once it gets new information. Nowadays, the use of deep learning in medical systems is crucial in various applications such as recognition, segmentation, and classification. Worldwide, lung illness is a prevalent occurrence in human beings which includes Covid-19, pneumonia, emphysema, asthma, lung cancer, etc. The early identification of lung diseases helps to detect the disease more accurately. Several deep learning techniques, including convolutional neural network, vanilla neural networks, visual geometry group-based networks and Caps Net, are used to predict the lung illness. To forecast different lung diseases from chest X-ray and CT scan pictures, typical CNN’s performance and learning framework is insufficient. This proposed work aims to build a lung disease detection model using CNN with various hyperparameter tuning to enhance the accuracy of the model. Also, the accuracy is associated with advanced methods to enhance the performance of the proposed work.

articleTitle: Resume Screening using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The rapid advancement of the technology field has ushered in a wave of employment opportunities across various sectors, necessitating organizations to efficiently sift through a multitude of resumes to identify the most suitable candidates for their specific job requirements. To address this challenge, we propose a research paper that presents a systematic approach to effectively sorting resumes based on company-specific requirements, enabling the identification of the most qualified candidates for specific job roles. This research paper introduces a cutting-edge solution that harnesses state-of-the-art technologies, including Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing (NLP), in conjunction with cosine similarity. A model has been developed to recognize keywords and extract pertinent information from job requirements provided by recruiting companies. To train this model, a comprehensive database of diverse resumes from various fields has been employed. The model is trained to exclusively search for keywords or requirements specified by the recruiting company, thereby sorting the resumes, accordingly, accepting those that align with the specified criteria, and dismissing those that fall short. The entire process is designed to optimize efficiency and streamline the candidate selection process.

articleTitle: Voice Assisted Text Summarizer Using NLP
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: A voice assisted text summarizer is a system that uses natural language processing (NLP) techniques to summarize long text documents into shorter, more concise versions that can be easily understood by users. The system can be activated by voice commands and is designed to facilitate the process of summarization, which is a time-consuming task for humans. The system employs various NLP techniques, such as sentence segmentation, word frequency analysis, and entity recognition, to identify the most relevant information in the text and generate a summary that captures the main points of the document. The system also uses machine learning algorithms to improve the quality of the summaries over time, as it learns from user feedback. The voice assistant functionality allows users to interact with the system hands-free, making it especially useful for people with visual impairments or those who are multitasking. Overall, a voice assisted text summarizer using NLP has the potential to improve productivity and make information more accessible to a wider audience. Text summaries can now be made in a variety of ways, but audio summaries still need to be created. The summaries’ audio versions can be listened to in order to understand the content. The necessary information can be heard while people are working on other tasks. Voice-assisted text summary generators are useful because they provide condensed versions that may be read and heard in a short amount of time for people who frequently lack the time to read lengthy books or listen to longer audios.

articleTitle: Advancements in Crown Sheath Rot Detection using DenseNet121 and UNet in Rice Plant Leaf Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This article aims to investigate the leaf spot disease in rice, a condition that has been observed to cause substantial reductions in crop yield, ranging from 10% to 50%. The disease is characterized by the appearance of circular lesions on the leaves of rice plants, which gradually expand and cover the entire leaf surface, leading to the eventual death of the affected leaves. In order to achieve automation in the detection and severity classification of the disease under investigation, a range of deep learning models were utilized. These models encompassed Faster DenseNet121 and UNet. These methods proposed in this study was trained and tested using a dataset consisting of 1120 images. The findings of the study indicate that the DenseNet121 approach that yielded the highest level of success demonstrated a noteworthy classification accuracy rate of 95.23%. The results obtained from the integration of image processing techniques with deep learning models demonstrated superior performance compared to the analysis solely based on deep learning models. The integration described in this study presents a novel approach to enhance the efficiency of diagnosing leaf spot disease on rice. By leveraging advanced technology, this integration aims to reduce the time required for diagnosis, minimize the occurrence of human errors, and facilitate the timely application of suitable pesticides to mitigate the detrimental effects of the disease.

articleTitle: Minimal Knee Joint Space Width Detection in Digital X-Ray Images using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This analysis aimed to evaluate the performance of a deep learning-driven method to locate minimal knee joint space width area (KJSW) and see how successfully a deep learning approach can locate mKJSW area from digital x-ray images. In 1848 knee data (digital X-ray images), I used 1752 data (X-ray images) for the study. This proposed method compares the KJSW area in lateral and medial sides, and detect the mKJSW area. Faster RCNN architecture and incorporate VGG -16 with transfer learning are trained to extract the image features to locate the mKJSW area in the digital knee joint X-ray images. The proposed approach located the mKJSW region with a localization accuracy of 98.6 %, indicating the potential use of mKJSW area detection. We have presented the automated deep learning approach to locate the mKJSW area. In addition to that, our proposed deep learning approach trained on both femur and tibial bone region from knee Anterior-Posterior (AP) view digital X-ray images perform better at locating mKJSW area than the reference model. The proposed approach will be used to evaluate knee joint OA and pain assessment.

articleTitle: Risk Management in Project Planning: A Comparative Analysis of Decision Trees and Monte Carlo Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Decision Trees and Monte Carlo Simulation are two popular methods for managing risks in project planning, and this paper compares and contrasts both. The goal is to give a thorough assessment of their performance by using three estimated values. For this evaluation, we looked at how well various approaches matched three important criteria: precision, usability, and adaptability. According to the data, Decision Trees achieve an average accuracy score of 88.5% whereas Monte Carlo Simulation routinely achieves a score of 91.0%. On top of that, with an average score of 94.7%, Monte Carlo Simulation shows a lot more ease of implementation than Decision Trees, which only manages 78.4%. With Decision Trees averaging 83.7% and Monte Carlo Simulation 88.3%, both approaches display similar versatility. With its higher accuracy and ease of application, Monte Carlo Simulation stands out as the most effective and user-friendly option for risk management in project planning, according to this comparative analysis. Nevertheless, Decision Trees can still be useful in less complex project planning scenarios when convenience is more important than precision. When choosing the best risk management strategy, project managers should think about their unique projects’ needs.

articleTitle: Weather Report Analysis Prediction using Machine Learning and Data Analytics Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Accurate and dependable forecasts are necessary for weather prediction, which is essential to many industries and everyday activities. This paper investigates the use of gradient-boosting algorithms in weather report analysis and prediction by utilizing the capabilities of data science approaches. The gradient boosting model is trained using features that include temperature, humidity, wind speed, and atmospheric pressure, all of which are derived from historical weather data. Since atmospheric conditions are chaotic, it is difficult to make precise predictions in this environment. Nevertheless, gradient-boosting algorithms are quite good at identifying complex relationships in the data. The key phases of this process—data collection, preprocessing, and feature engineering—are highlighted in this paper. The paper provides a thorough approach to developing algorithms with an emphasis on algorithm selection, hyperparameter adjustment, and thorough assessment. strong forecasting models. Additionally discussed are the function of ensemble methods and model generalization, emphasizing the need for constant upkeep and monitoring to ensure peak performance. The results highlight how gradient-boosting algorithms might improve the precision of weather forecasts. Additionally, the incorporation of data science techniques demonstrates a methodical approach to deriving significant insights from intricate meteorological data. This research adds to a better knowledge of how to combine cutting-edge machine learning algorithms and domain expertise to address the complexities of weather report processing and prediction, as weather-related difficulties continue to arise.

articleTitle: GitHub Bug Classification Using Pipeline Approach in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: GitHub bug classification refers to the process of automatically categorizing bug reports or issues on GitHub into predefined categories based on their text content. This process helps to improve the efficiency of software development teams by reducing the time spent on manual issue triage. By using machine learning techniques such as Naive Bayes, Decision Trees, and Logistic Regression, a model can be trained on a dataset of past issues and then used to classify new issues as they are submitted. This study aims to build a machine-learning model for GitHub bug classification using a pipeline approach and evaluate its accuracy, precision, and recall performance.The study also includes a comprehensive literature review of bug tracking and classification techniques, existing systems and approaches, and evaluation metrics for performance measures. The research design and strategy, data collection and sources, and ethical considerations are also discussed in detail.The practice of automatically classifying bug reports or issues on GitHub into specified categories based on their text content is called GitHub bug categorization. By cutting down on the time needed for manual problem triage, this technique increases the effectiveness of software development teams.

articleTitle: EmotionTracker: Real-time Facial Emotion Detection with OpenCV and DeepFace
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper introduces a real-time facial emotion detection and analysis system, leveraging a Streamlit-based web interface for user interaction and video processing. The motivation behind this research lies in the increasing relevance of facial emotion detection in diverse applications, including human-computer interaction and mental health monitoring. The project addresses the challenge of efficiently capturing, analyzing, and presenting emotional insights from user-uploaded videos. The primary problem tackled by the system is the need for a comprehensive and user-friendly solution to extract emotion-related information from facial expressions in real-time video streams. Employing a combination of OpenCV, DeepFace, and Streamlit, the system processes uploaded videos, detects facial emotions at each timestamp, and generates an emotion-annotated output. The methodology involves integrating OpenCV for video processing, DeepFace for emotion analysis, and Streamlit for an interactive user interface. Results showcase the system’s ability to identify dominant emotions, quantify occurrences, and present the findings in an easily comprehensible manner. The implications of this work extend to various domains, such as enhancing human-computer interaction experiences and contributing to mental health research. The user-friendly interface and efficient emotion detection mechanisms make this system a valuable tool for researchers, practitioners, and developers seeking to explore and implement facial emotion analysis in real-world applications.

articleTitle: Stock Market Prediction Analysis Using Machine Learning Transformer Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Stock market is one of the foundations that supports a nation's economy. People have been investing in the stock market for many years in an effort to maximize the return on their capital. Therefore, having a prediction model that can correctly forecast future stock prices is essential. It is not an impossible task with the aid of machine learning, as the different machine learning techniques if properly modeled, may be able to produce the best prediction values. The investors would then be free to choose whether to buy, sell, or hold the share. The purpose of this article is to more accurately forecast the future of a company's financial stocks using a transformer model and suggests utilizing sentiment and historical data to predict stock analysis effectively. The movement of stock prices and the release of news stories have been found to be strongly correlated, according to an analysis of the sentiment analysis literature. To more properly predict the stock analysis, we have combined these criteria into this paper.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Vision-Based Ibot-Kare-Robot for Automation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Our surroundings are brimming with visual signals that are designed to aid human navigation. For instance, there are room numbers next to doors and building directories at the entrances. We will design a more reliable and useful system by creating robot wheelchair systems that can comprehend these cues. The designs and developments of our robot’s wheelchair systems, Wheel, as well as its vision-based navigation technologies, are discussed in this study. The robot wheelchair system builds maps of the environments it travels through using stereo vision; these maps can subsequently be annotated with the data gained from the sign. We also discussed the incorporation of an assistive robot arm that will help with opening doors and pushing the buttons on elevators. numerous parties have constructed and conducted an extensive study on mobile double-wheeled self-balancing robots for academic, recreational, and commercial objectives. The designs and assembly of a compact, autonomous, two-wheeled robot platform are described in this study. The robot is quick, has several onboard sensors that let it navigate through an unstructured environment, can jump over minor obstacles, and can communicate wirelessly over short and long distances. The up-boards single camera machined visions module, which aids the robots in recognizing impediments, is one of the features. This disclosure is intended to help other researchers working on related projects enhance the design of these devices.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Tourism Recommender System Using KNN and RBM Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Tourism holds a pivotal position in the nation's economic landscape, serving as a major driving force and playing a crucial role in shaping the trajectory of the industry. The desire for travel has increased over the years, leading to a rise in the number of tourists. As a result, businesses on a global and local scale, as well as governments, invest heavily in the industry. Investments mainly focus on providing tourists with comprehensive tour and hotel packages. Despite government investments in the maintenance and promotion of tourist attractions, there is frequently insufficient focus on enhancing the overall tourist experience. To address this gap, we aim to implement an innovative real-time recommender system that goes beyond conventional information provision and offers recommendations based on user preferences. We recognize the evolving complexities and dynamics of recommender system environments and strive to adapt to the changing sources and diversity of information available at runtime.We aim to create a proficient touring recommender system with real-time capabilities, guaranteeing that visitors obtain prompt ideas that enhance their overall experience. The objective is to provide an all-encompassing suggestion framework that assists travelers in the first phase of choosing which nation to visit and thereafter offers a thorough guide for their whole holiday. We are dedicated to providing tourists with the best possible experience, aiming to eliminate the need for external assistance. Key features of the application encompass providing comprehensive information on accommodations, dining options, and attractions, utilizing the user's current location for a personalized experience. This information will be tailored based on factors such as budget, popularity, and other relevant characteristics. Additionally, we plan to implement a timetabled feature that assists tourists in planning their activities based on the duration of their stay. Real-time assistance will also be a prominent feature, ensuring that users have continuous support during their travel experiences. In essence, our mission is to redefine the tourism experience by combining real-time recommendations with a user-centric approach, empowering tourists to make informed decisions and enjoy a seamless and memorable journey.

articleTitle: Advanced Liver Tumor Detection: Cascaded Fully Convolutional Neural Networks for Enhanced Precision
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Liver Tumour is one of the major causes of human death. Lack of early recognition results in major health problems and may even cause harm to life. Identification and medication of tumour at the earliest will reduce the risk of life. Tumor detection through manual methods is a time-consuming process. Automatic tumor detection will overcome this problem; even though there are many methods for this process, it still has some drawbacks like lack of early-stage detection and inaccuracy in the detection of larger cells. This paper highlights a deep-learning method for liver cancer identification and segmentation. This can be done by using Fully cascaded Convolutional Neural network (CNN) that will help to compensate for the above drawbacks. This method will increase the accuracy of the segmented image and reduce the time consumption.

articleTitle: Time Series Classification using Attention-Based LSTM and CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Time series classification has many real-world applications, including medical diagnosis, financial forecasting, and environmental monitoring. Accurately classifying time series data can provide valuable insights and help make informed decisions in various fields. This paper proposes the attention-based LSTM - CNN framework for classifying time series data. Our framework incorporates joint extraction of spatio-temporal features from a convolutional neural network and attention-based long- and short-term memory. The extracted features are fed into a Random Forest classifier to obtain the final output classes. We have used the Wafer dataset from the UCR repository for experimentation. An accuracy of 99.86% was achieved for the proposed model, hence transcending the performance of the other baseline models.

articleTitle: Diadisc: A Machine Learning Approach for Classification and Prediction of Diabetes Mellitus
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Diabetes is a category of metabolic illnesses characterized by persistently elevated blood sugar levels. Frequent urination, increased thirst, and increased hunger are all signs of elevated blood sugar. Diabetes can lead to a wide range of consequences if ignored. To accurately predict whether or not the patients in the data set have diabetes, we are trying to create a machine-learning model. Our goal in this study is to determine a patient’s likelihood of having diabetes based on a variety of factors, including glucose level, insulin, age, and BMI. Our goal in this study is to determine a patient’s likelihood of having diabetes based on a variety of factors, including glucose level, insulin, age, and BMI. We will complete every stage, including data collection and model implementation. We compare multiple machine learning algorithms using the accuracy score measure during the model evaluation process to see which is better. Then, we use Flask, a Python micro framework, to develop a web application.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Non-Contact Heart Rate Prediction: Integrating ICA and PCA in rPPGNet
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Health monitoring is crucial in assessing an individual’s health condition. Assessing our health can be easily done by measuring our heart rate. Variations in heart rate are common among individuals, and an abnormally elevated or reduced resting heart rate can indicate potential health issues. Various techniques, including ECG and PPG, can measure heart rate. These treatments have a drawback in that they are intrusive and involve continual contact with the human body. To address this issue, a novel solution that utilises a camera is suggested. This approach employs a blind source separation algorithm to extract the heart rate signal from the facial image. The Viola-Jones algorithm is employed for facial detection and tracking. The Fast Independent Component Analysis (ICA) algorithm is utilised to extract the heart rate information from any noise and artefacts. The rPPGNET algorithm is utilised to normalise the signal. The data has been effectively validated using real-time video.

articleTitle: Customer Relationship Management Segment Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Customer relationship management (CRM) entails the integration of individuals, procedures, and technology with the aim of comprehending the clientele of a company. CRM, an acronym for customer relationship management, is rooted in long-standing principles. Presently, there is widespread recognition that the way in which customers are comprehended and treated significantly influences a company’s future success and profitability. Consequently, businesses are increasingly allocating substantial investments to enhance their customer management strategies. CRM embodies a comprehensive strategy for acquiring customers, fostering their loyalty, and improving customer profitability, behavior and satisfaction. The proposed system incorporates numerous activities aimed at automating the entire process through seamless database integration. This ensures a user-friendly interface for effective interaction with the provided application. K-means clustering is used for the datasets that inhibit customer segmentation on different categories and provide the output with the same CSV data to the user with the segmented list of customers.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security and Transparency Through the Integration of Blockchain and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This article examines a new strategy in improving security and trust by fusing blockchain technology with machine learning techniques. This synergy exploits the decentralisation and immutability properties of blockchains alongside analytical capabilities provided by ML models to achieve optimal value creation. Through strict scrutiny, the employed technique reveals efficacy as regards boosting security measures as well as fostering transparency in all sorts of operations. It shows how such an integrated approach can take up issues pertaining to the problem of securing contemporary data which will pave way for reliable, trustable, strong systems. For this reason, it becomes possible to widen the application of these safe and transparent technologies as a contribution to enlargement into broader fields of science.

articleTitle: Multimodal Emotion Recognition using Acoustic and Visual Features
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Emotions are strong messengers that convey our inner experiences, wants, and aspirations. Furthermore, correctly understanding the emotions allows us to negotiate life’s problems, make educated decisions, build meaningful connections with others, and develop emotional intelligence. This research aims at automatically determining the emotion of a person accurately using multimodal emotion recognition strategy which is a fusion of acoustic and visual modalities. The RAVDESS dataset has been used for the purpose of emotion detection. Machine learning algorithms such SVM, Random Forest, KNN, Gradient Boosting, MLP, Decision Tree, Nave Bayes, and Ensemble Learning techniques were used for testing and training to identify emotion from the auditory components. The Le-Net 5 model was used to identify emotion from visual imagery. Metrics like accuracy, confusion matrix and training testing validation loss were used to evaluate the performance of these models. The proposed technique uses high-quality audio and video data, with the acoustic ensemble method attaining 65% accuracy and the video CNN model obtaining an accuracy of 86%. The recognition accuracy increases to 94.5% when the acoustic and visual components are combined at model level.

articleTitle: Dry Bean Classification using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: One of the largest consuming food products in the world is the pulse. Presence of vitamins and protein content makes dry beans in improving the health. Production of dry beans depends on the quality of seeds. Hence, Application of machine learning algorithms to classify the seeds has a massive impact in sustainable farming system. This study proposes an application of deep learning algorithm to classify the dry beans seed. The raw dataset was used from the UCI machine learning repository. A balanced dataset using synthetic minority oversampling technique is created to overcome the classification bias. Long short-term memory (LSTM), a deep learning model has been applied to balanced dataset. The developed model has been validated with 10-fold cross validation approach. Test results indicate the proposed model can classify dry beans accurately and found to be superior than the existing results reported in the literature.

articleTitle: Identification of Ankle Implants Using Anterior Posterior View
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Identification of an orthopedic Ankle Implant is highly important before deciding a revision surgery of joint replacement. The inability to identify an implant at the right time can lead to increased trauma to patients. The paper proposes a unique framework to identify the model and make of Ankle implants from radiography images of Anterior Posterior views using Deep learning. The work compares 3 different rigorously fine-tuned pretrained models to achieve the successful classification of implants. The use of the Inception V3 model provides the highest accuracy of 96.67% and an F1 score of 0.9662 in classification showing higher dominance in the accurate identification of Ankle implants.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms to predict the Tropical Cyclones
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Tropical cyclones (TC) are powerful weather phenomena characterized by low-sea level pressure systems with rotating winds. Accurate classification of these cyclones plays a crucial role in predicting their intensity, potential damage, and issuing timely warnings. In this paper, we explore and compare various machine learning model’s accuracy in the classification of tropical cyclones based on multiple meteorological features, including sea level pressure (SLP) drop, maximum sustained surface winds (MSW), estimated central sea level pressure from centre of the eye of the tropical cyclones, latitude, & longitude are 5 features. The following algorithms are used for comparative analysis of tropical cyclone using best track data: Random Forest, C4.5 Decision Tree, Logistic Regression, Nearest Centroid Classifier, Extreme Learning Machine, Linear Discriminant Analysis, Quadratic Discriminant Analysis, and Long Short-Term Memory. When we use the above said 5 features, it is observed that the Random Forest is obtained the maximum accuracy of 99.10%, followed closely by C4.5 decision tree with an accuracy of 98.54%. Logistic Regression obtained accuracies of 94.06%. LDA, QDA, NCC, LSTM and ELM achieved accuracies of 92.94%, 98.09%, 83.76%, 50.62% and 20.5%, respectively.

articleTitle: Enhancing Handwritten Character Recognition with XGBoost: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Recognizing handwritten text poses a significant challenge due to the distinct characteristics inherent in each individual’s handwriting. Consequently, recognition systems must exhibit adaptability to identify similar or dissimilar characters with varying traits. Particularly challenging is the recognition of characters in ancient documents, where the presence of numerous types of noise introduces complexity. When digitizing these historical records, diverse noise patterns emerge, significantly impacting recognition systems. Hence, the essential elements of a successful recognition system encompass the conversion of historical documents into digital format, the application of suitable preprocessing methods, and the utilisation of a resilient classifier. This study presents a thorough system for recognising handwritten characters in English and Telugu, which utilises a deep convolutional neural network. The proposed system achieves an impressive accuracy of 95.20% with minimal model loss, underscoring its efficiency and effectiveness in handling the complexities of handwritten character recognition, especially in the context of ancient documents.

articleTitle: Best Classifier Analysis for Classification-Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Machine Learning extends everywhere in the world. Prediction based on the classification of data, misprediction may lead the model to failure. Hence, it is necessary to learn the traditional machine learning algorithms and how the Machine Learning traditional algorithms can work in prediction datasets, such as medical diagnosis. To build a good prediction model, which classifier can be chosen is discussed with intense care. The study uses traditional machine learning algorithms such as SVM, KNN, Naive Bayes, and Random forest to build the best prediction model. In this paper, a proper study of classification algorithms has been done. Finally, this paper concludes with the best machine learning algorithms among the above said algorithms with their improved precision.

articleTitle: Intelligence Non-Invasive Blood Group Prediction using Thermography
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Blood bunch forecast is pivotal in bonding medication, as it guarantees protected and compelling blood bondings. Predicting a person’s blood group has traditionally been done through serological methods, which look at whether or not particular antigens are present on the surface of red blood cells. Be that as it may, these techniques are tedious and require specific hardware and prepared faculty. Thermography is a method that uses infrared imaging to detect temperature differences [1] on the surface of an object or organism. As a result, there is a need for methods that are both non-invasive and quick to predict blood groups. This method has been utilized in different clinical applications, including bosom disease recognition and skin temperature checking. On account of blood bunch expectation, thermography can be utilized to recognize temperature contrasts brought about by the presence or nonattendance of explicit antigens on the outer layer of red platelets [2]. To use thermography for blood group prediction, a thermograph image of a person it can be taken using a thermal camera. The image can then be analyzed to detect temperature differences on the surface of the it. These temperature differences can be compared to a database of known blood group patterns to predict the person’s blood group [3].

articleTitle: Detection and Categorization of Brain Tumors Through Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Brain tumor identification can be extremely challenging in the early stages of life. But now that many deep learning and machine learning algorithms have been developed, it has advanced. Automatic identification of brain tumors is a hot topic these days. The brain tumor is located using the patient's MRI pictures. The proposed system aims to determine whether a patient has a brain tumor. Early tumor detection is critical to the patient's long-term health. Identifying these brain tumors and improving the detection precision have been the subject of numerous studies. Radiologists or clinical specialists perform the most difficult and time-consuming tasks: tumor area segmentation, detection, and extraction.

articleTitle: Data Analytics on the Nano Composite Behavior of Circular CFST Columns under Axial Load
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The current study examines the buckling behavior of steel circular tube columns filled with Nano Concrete using ANSYS software (NCFCST). The whole strength of NCFCST, simple CFCST, and hollow columns (HC) is predicted by a FEA model. The FE models are constructed and validated using experimental data concerning ultimate strength, load-deformation histories, and failure processes. In comparison to hollow columns and plain concrete steel circular tube columns (PCFCST), the testing findings shown that the NCFCST strength rose and buckling behaviours decreased.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Method of Personality Prediction System Based on Signature
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Personality characteristics are essential to comprehending human behaviour and may yield insightful knowledge in a variety of fields, such as psychology, marketing, and human-computer interaction. The five factors of the big five personality’s extraversion, agreeableness, conscientiousness, neuroticism, and openness are identified using a deep learning approach shown in this research that uses writing styles. Our method seeks to automatically and precisely forecast a person’s personality traits by analyzing written content, such as essays, blog posts, or social media updates.

articleTitle: Pneumonia Classification from CXR images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Pneumonia is one of the most common and serious respiratory infections. It occurs due to inflammation of alveoli and air sacs filled with other substances like pus and mucus. It affects the lungs and makes it delicate to breathe. Colorful pathogens can cause pneumonia. Numerous algorithms have surfaced to describe pneumonia. In this paper, we will see one similar effective and accurate algorithm that detects pneumonia by using casketX-Ray images(CXR). This paper introduces an LSTM model that uses deep learning and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to detect pneumonia. The model is also suitable to separate bacterial and viral pneumonia. A similar bracket will be veritably helpful for croakers. The results of our work show that we’re suitable to separate COVID pneumonia and bacterial pneumonia. As COVID-19 pneumonia is contagious, we can take preventive measures fluently with the proposed system. Our system provides a delicacy of 93.72 percent and perceptivity of 92.80 percent. The deep literacy model that we achieved made for better perfection.

articleTitle: Enhancement of CURE algorithm using Map-Reduce Technique with Parallelism
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The extraction of useful information from huge databases is one of the key areas of data mining and is open for research. Clustering integrates the data with higher similarity into the same group, enhancing the extraction process. Clustering Using Representatives (CURE) is an efficient clustering algorithm that handles voluminous data. However, CURE uses sampling, which encounters scalability and accuracy issues while processing huge databases. This limitation can be repressed by using the Map-reduce technique in CURE instead of sampling. The clustering performance can be further enhanced by using parallelism integrated into the CURE algorithm to reduce processing time and enhance efficiency.

articleTitle: Instagram - Driven Social Media Trend Forecasting with Learning Algorithm using Live Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Instagram trend analysis and prediction can be achieved using data analytics and machine learning techniques to examine patterns, behaviors, and content trends on the Instagram platform. Social media platforms, especially Instagram, have become one of the major sources of data for trend forecasting. This requires understanding trends to allow Instagram users to stay relevant to the current trends and current popularity. This is helpful for content creators and business purposes etc. By this the users can also be more beneficial with the content creator, identifying various trends that occur and are followed in the social media. It helps business people in making decisions. Instagram Trend Analysis results in identifying future trends earlier and with the help of data-driven decision-making. This paper aims to present a comprehensive framework for predicting emerging trends on Instagram through a combination of machine learning techniques and advanced data visualization techniques. We delve into the intricacies of data collection, preprocessing, feature engineering, and model development to uncover patterns and anticipate trends. Importantly, we emphasize the significance of effective data visualization in conveying insights and aiding decision-making. Our research showcases the potential of harnessing Instagram data for trend prediction and provides valuable insights into the strengths and limitations of this methodology

articleTitle: Innovative Parkinson's Disease Detection System: LORA-EMG Fusion for Enhanced Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The increasing expense of healthcare and the steadily rising number of persons with disabilities who need treatment and ongoing rehabilitation are two of the main issues many countries are facing this century. We now have a variety of new opportunities in wireless health thanks to the development of microelectronics and potent mobile devices that enable us to take on this significant challenge.
