articleTitle: Impact of Machine Learning on Personality Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Information Science and man-made intelligence are changing the planet through specialized changes. We can notice numerous machine learning applications in our everyday lives, except one of the best utilizations of AI is to group people in light of their character attributes. Each individual in the world is one of a kind and conveys an exceptional character type. articleTitle: Skin Cancer Classification using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Melanoma is a disease that affects a huge number of individuals. Different approaches, like deep learning procedures, have been demonstrated to be exceptionally exact in characterizing images. First, image processing techniques will be used to evacuate undesirable artefacts and then automatically segment the skin lesion. Next, the classification process is done by CNN (Convolution Neural Network). To detect the abnormality of images, the classifier utilises pre-processed output and original input images from the PH2 dataset. The better performance will be evaluated with the help of accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity.

articleTitle: Customer Segmentation Using Supervised and Unsupervised Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Customer segmentation is an important method for any business and startup to understand the behaviour of the customers. It helps provide targeted marketing and service strategies. This method mainly divides the customers based on age, gender, behaviour, geography, and purchasing behaviour. By using this method, we can tailor our marketing campaigns. Machine learning is a powerful tool for customer segmentation. It can analyze historical data and identify patterns that cannot be found manually. This project aims to develop a machine-learning model for customer segmentation. The input of our project is historical data. The second step is to pre-process the data to ensure the quality of the data. The third step is to divide the data into two parts: train data and test data. The train data will be eighty percent, and the test data will be 20 percent. Then machine learning algorithms like k means clustering and Navy Bayes are trained on the train data to divide the customers into groups. After training the data is completed, and it is evaluated with the help of evaluation methods. With the help of this project, one can easily segment their customers and can build customized strategies for every segmentation of customers. The main aim of companies is to organize customers and provide efficient services for every segment. It can be attained by our project in a very efficient way.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Student Engagement using Deep Learning in E-learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The world wide learning system has been profoundly affected by the COVID-19 pandemic, leading to millions of students unable to attend physical schools. As a response, educational institutions have rapidly adopted online learning platforms. However, ensuring student engagement during online lectures has been a major challenge. The sudden shift from offline to online learning has disrupted the sense of physical connection, affecting both students and teachers. To tackle this issue, we have compared and analysed various deep learning-based model such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Vision Transformers (ViT), and DenseNet that assesses student engagement during virtual classes by analysing various features, including the student’s displayed emotions such as happiness, sadness, anger, and fear. This proposed methodology aims to enhance digital learning by helping educational institutions create more engaging and effective online learning experiences. This study highlights the superior performance of LSTM and DenseNet deep learning models in assessing student engagement during online classes, providing significant support for further developments in the e-learning environment.

articleTitle: Optimization of Hugging Face Transformers for Fake News Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The upsurge of fake news in recent times, facilitated due to the swift dissemination of information on social media, has necessitated the development of advanced detection techniques. This research focuses on optimizing the Hugging Face Transformer models – a cutting-edge Natural Language Processing (NLP) tool – to enhance fake news detection. These models are widely recognized for their superior performance in understanding and generating human language. However, their application in fake news detection remains under-explored. Thus, this paper explores how Python, a high-level programming language known for its simplicity and robustness, can be used to fine-tune these models for this purpose. The primary objective is to improve their speed, efficiency, and accuracy in detecting fake news. We propose a comprehensive framework that uses Python-based methodologies to tweak various aspects of the Hugging Face Transformer models, such as their architecture, training paradigms, and hyperparameters. The expected outcome is a significant improvement in the models’ performance metrics, which will be evaluated using standard benchmarks within the fake-news detection domain. Overall, this research paves the way for harnessing the full potential of Hugging Face Transformers in curbing the menace of fake news, thus contributing to a more reliable and truthful digital information ecosystem.

articleTitle: Liver Disease Prediction using Hybrid Support Vector Machine and Fuzzy Centroid based Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In numerous nations, liver illnesses are becoming one of the leading causes of death. Because of a variety of factors, the number of patients with liver disease has been steadily growing. Over dosage of alcohol, breathing of toxic fumes, plastics, plastic dust narcotics and etc., are also some factors of liver diseases. In 2023 researchers says in survey, 73% person’s blood contains plastic dusts. These types of diseases can lead to a severe disease, including liver cancer, lungs cancer, etc., The various supervised machine learning algorithms such as naïve bayes classification, Support Vector Machine, K-Nearest neighbor classification, Decision Tree algorithm etc., introduced to classify and predict the different types of diseases including liver disease and its variants. Each and everyone has its own uses has its own advantages and disadvantages. To improve the performance of liver disease prediction with the help of machine learning algorithm, here used the merging of supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithm, which is called semi supervised machine learning algorithm. This is also called as hybrid algorithm with help of support vector machine and centroid based clustering algorithm. Due to seriousness of this disease, today many researchers are involved working on the prediction of liver illness. For exact prediction and proper treatment here first used SVM to predict whether the patient has disease or not. After positive prediction of liver disease apply centroid based clustering algorithm to cluster seriousness of disease. In order to lessen the strain on clinicians, the UCI machine repository data set was utilized to test prediction systems. In that work, we suggested employing hybrid SVM and Fuzzy centroid based to predict the patient’s liver disease and also able to find how much it is affected and suggest the patient to what type of treatment can take and what type of food diet, exercise, etc., can be followed. For the result, here used the percentage of people who develop illness as both good and negative information. As a result, the outputs of the given proposed hybrid SVM with fuzzy centroid based clustering model produced best performance than existing methods.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Cluster Analysis for Healthcare Data Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The use of cutting-edge technology in the medical field results in the production of massive volumes of data on a daily basis. Various categories of information are applied in the domain of healthcare, including clinic information, medical record data, and genetic information. In addition, real-time monitoring in the medical industry produces enormous volumes of data, and properly interpreting such enormous amounts of data is a significant problem. The evaluation of medical information becomes more required so that suitable drugs may be supplied and issues can be avoided by taking appropriate measures depending on the history of the patient. Automation makes data analysis more effective, but performance might deteriorate when there are problems with data integrity, diversity, or consistency. Automation makes data analysis more effective. In order to handle the management of massive amounts of data, many models that are powered by neural networks have been developed; still researchers are currently attempting to develop a superior model that is more accurate. Hence, fuzzy c denotes the process of clustering, whereas generative adversarial networks are used in this study to clusters and classify medical data, aiming to achieve the maximum degree of efficiency in classification. The experiment will use both the benchmark lung cancer sample and the arrhythmias sample. The proposed model achieves a maximum accuracy of 97.3% for dataset 1 and 98.2% for dataset 2, outperforming other methods such as support vector machine, decision tree, and random forest algorithms.

articleTitle: Sales Forecasting using SARIMAX for B2C
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Sales forecasting is the process of predicting future sales and revenue for a business or organization. It involves using historical sales data, market analysis, and various quantitative and qualitative methods to make educated estimates about future sales performance. The primary goal of sales forecasting is to provide valuable insights and information that can guide business decisions, resource allocation, and strategic planning. Accurate sales predictions enable businesses to avoid overstocking or understocking situations, optimizing their inventory levels to meet customer demand while minimizing carrying costs. In this paper, we will see about one such efficient and accurate algorithm that forecast the sales based on the historical values and its seasonality. A SARIMAX model has been proposed in this paper which is the seasonal version of the ARIMA model to predict the future sales. The model is also enables the business people to view the sales based on its periodicity. Such classification will be very helpful for business people to identify the sales for the particular period or month. A graph is plotted for the forecasted value based in the inputs from the individual. This helps the individual to avoid the overstocking and understocking of goods. Our system provides rmse value of 337.5 whereas the mape value as 6.97. The error rate of the system is comparatively low.

articleTitle: Intelligent Pathological Voice Detection Based on Social Media Application using Conditional Random Field Contrasted and Support Vector Machine Calculation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The target of this exploration article is to make a framework for recognizing voice problems that is prepared to do consequently distinguishing obsessive voices from web-based entertainment stages in medical services settings, using imaginative calculations like Restrictive Irregular Field (CRF) and Backing Vector Machine (SVM). Materials and Techniques: The dataset utilized in this paper is the Pathology Voice Recognition Values dataset, containing 41,090 preparation voice documents. The dataset was gotten from Kaggle, a generally used stage by understudies, AI professionals, and information researchers for different examination purposes. The dataset is alluded to as the Voice Location dataset in this review. The information source connection can be gotten to from Kaggle’s site (“Kaggle” 2022). An Original Restrictive Irregular Field calculation and backing vector machine calculation strategies are reenacted. The example size is determined utilizing G power of 80% for two groups, and this study employs 20 examples for every one of the calculations. Results: In view of gotten results CRF has Better precision (84.22%) contrasted with help vector machine exactness (81.29%). Measurable importance among CRF and support vector machine calculations was viewed as p=0.000 (Free Example T-test p<0.05) two-followed, which shows that there is an importance between the gatherings. End: In light of the outcomes, for recognizing obsessive voices in a medical care framework, CRF calculations will generally yield better outcomes looked at than help vector machine calculations.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction Using Time Embedding and Attention Mechanism in Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Predicting stock prices accurately is a complex task that involves analyzing a wide range of factors such as company performance, industry trends, market conditions, and even global events. Recently, transformer-based models have shown promising results for sequential data analysis, including stock price prediction. However, predicting stock prices accurately requires considering the temporal patterns in the data, which can be achieved by incorporating time embedding techniques into the model. Here in this paper a transformer-based model was proposed for stock price prediction that incorporates time embedding and the moving average technique. The proposed model uses historical stock prices and financial indicators as input, and the output is the predicted stock prices. Time embedding is used to capture the temporal patterns in the stock prices, and the moving average technique is used to remove the noise in the input data and improve the models accuracy. The performance of proposed model which is based on transformer is evaluated on publicly available dataset of various companies i.e IBM, APPLE and TATAMOTORS. The results we achieved is really good and transformer-based models have really proven to be suited for Stock price prediction.

articleTitle: An Accurate Prediction of Medical Insurance Cost Using Forest Regression Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The project is a health insurance forecasting system powered by artificial intelligence. Health insurance has become one of the most important areas of study since the COVID-19 outbreak, and there have recently been various attempts to discover solutions to this problem. To predict insurance prices, the dataset includes age, gender, BMI, smoking habits, the number of children, and other characteristics. Medical insurance cost prediction is a crucial task that can assist people and insurance companies plan their finances and premiums. The model provided more accuracy for predicting medical insurance with the help of regression techniques. For classification and regression, rather than being a boosting approach, random forest is a bagging technique. In random forests, the trees are arranged in parallel. When these trees are being built, there is no contact between them. Combining multiple decision trees also helps random forests handle noisy data and outliers effectively, as the averaging process mitigates their impact on the final prediction. Additionally, random forests provide a feature importance score, indicating each feature's contribution in making accurate predictions. This can be particularly valuable in understanding the underlying relationships within the data and identifying key factors driving the outcomes. As a result, random forests are widely used in various fields such as finance, healthcare, and marketing for their ability to deliver reliable and interpretable predictions.

articleTitle: Detecting Objects in Surveillance Videos with Deep Neural Networks for Crime Scene Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Surveillance systems are critical components of modern security and forensic investigation, and their efficacy is strongly reliant on precise object detection in video recordings. This study looks into the use of deep neural networks to improve object detection in surveillance films for crime scene analysis. This study investigates the capabilities of cutting-edge deep learning architectures in recognizing and classifying objects in various surveillance contexts. The study’s findings are extensive, including detection accuracy metrics for numerous item classes such as “Person,” “Vehicle,” and “Suspicious Item.” Precision values range from 0.78 to 0.92, recall values range from 0.82 to 0.90, and F1 scores range from 0.80 to 0.90, demonstrating the models’ ability to recognize objects accurately, but with variances among item categories. This study also looks into computational performance, offering information about inference times and GPU utilization. Inference times for ResNet-50 and YOLOv3 are 15 ms and 20 ms, respectively, with GPU use percentages of 75% and 90%. These findings provide useful information for picking models that fulfill real-time processing needs while optimizing computational resources. The research also examines the connection between video resolution, detection speed (up to 30 frames per second), and average detection accuracy. Lower resolutions allow for faster processing, but at the expense of accuracy, whilst higher resolutions provide finer details at the expense of larger computational needs. These trade-offs are critical considerations when building surveillance systems to meet certain operational requirements.

articleTitle: Hyper Triglycerides Prognosis Using Machine Learning and Data Science
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This study investigates the prognostic potential of machine learning and data science in evaluating hypertriglyceridemia, a condition linked to various health risks. Triglycerides, a substantial component of body fat derived from dietary intake, are intricately associated with these risks. The research explores the use of data science methodologies, especially machine learning algorithms, for precise prognoses. The integration of artificial neural networks and diverse data sources contributes to advancing predictive models, aiming to enhance understanding and improve early detection and preventive interventions for hypertriglyceridemia. This study also emphasizes the role of triglycerides in the body, originating from dietary sources such as butter and oils. Excess calories, not immediately utilized, transform into stored triglycerides, released by the body for energy distribution through VLDL cholesterol particles. Elevated triglyceride levels correlate with increased risks of heart disease, coronary artery disease (CAD), stroke, and chronic conditions affecting the liver and kidneys. The rapid progress in data science, driven by diverse data sources, positions the field among the fastest-evolving. Integration with machine learning technologies significantly improves healthcare solutions, particularly in disease prediction through artificial neural networks. These advancements have a substantial impact on addressing heart disease (4.4 million annual deaths according to the WHF dossier) and cholesterol-related fatalities (estimated at nearly 2.6 million by the WHO).

articleTitle: Alzheimer’s Disease Prediction using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with Generative Adversarial Network (GAN)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Alzheimer’s is the most common form of dementia in older individuals, which presents a global health challenge with 10 million new cases annually. This neurological disorder causes neurodegenerative alterations in the brain to unfold gradually, commencing with mild memory impairment and then escalating to loss of social interaction and awareness of the environment. Alzheimer Disease International (ADI) believes that 75% of dementia cases globally go undetected, making the early diagnosis challenging. Currently, stopping the development of Alzheimer’s disease is difficult since there are no viable diagnosis and treatment solutions available. To overcome these challenges, there is now great interest in using machine learning (ML) for early diagnosis of metabolic disorders such as Alzheimer’s. In this work, we propose utilizing a deep convolutional neural network to detect the different phases of Alzheimer’s disease using brain MRI structural data analysis. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) aids in the early detection of Alzheimer’s disease and achieves greater efficacy for initial-stage detection. Clinicians can use the suggested categorization approach to diagnose these disorders much earlier. With these ML algorithms, it is highly advantageous to reduce yearly death rates of Alzheimer’s disease in early diagnosis. The suggested technique achieves improved results, with an approved mean score of 96.1% on Alzheimer’s Disease test data. Compared to previous efforts, the current score for accuracy is much greater.

articleTitle: Trade Discount Optimization for E-Commerce Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving landscape of e-commerce, the strategic interplay between pricing, profitability, and market competitiveness has become increasingly intricate. This paper presents a novel approach to optimizing gross margins in e-commerce platforms through a meticulous discount strategy. By leveraging historical data and predictive analytics, we forecast item sales, accounting for variables such as previous discount levels and the age of items. Our methodology is designed to fine-tune discounts within a predefined range while ensuring maximum gross margin and maintaining revenue stability.

articleTitle: Data Visualization and Analytics for Price Elasticity on Commodities Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Nowadays, many commodities are being sold across restaurants. Many commodities would earn profit to the seller on the other hand some may provide loss. Predicting the price of a commodity leads to success in terms of sales. Machine learning practices are used to forecast the price elasticities of various commodities. The price elasticity model with the amalgamation of Ordinary least squares will lead to perceiving the seller’s demand. This process leads to an increased profit for Quick Service Restaurants. The seller can identify where the raw materials can be purchased very cheaply according to that price can be also increased or decreased on the facets like commodity exigency and relativism with the antiquated price.

articleTitle: Utilising a Machine Learning Model with Feature Selection from the Salp Swarm Algorithm for Automated Spam Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Automated spam detection is a prevalent use case that involves the filtration and identification of unsolicited or undesirable messages, specifically spam comments or spam emails With the advent of mass mailing technology came an explosion of spam, and spam detection systems became an absolute must for keeping up with the problem. In order to identify spam using machine learning (ML), it is necessary to build a model that can separate incoming messages into two groups: spam and legitimate communications. This categorization relies on detecting specific traits and patterns derived from an appropriately annotated dataset. The dataset has provided these traits and trends. A number of approaches based on machine learning algorithms have been proposed for use in spam identification. Improving spam detection rates while lowering processing cost was the goal of developing algorithms for feature selection and parameter optimisation. The model described in this article is Auto-Spam Detection with Salp Swarm Algorithm based Feature Selection with Machine Learning (ASD-SSFSML). In order to detect and categorise spam, the ASD-SSFSML methodology employs feature selection and classification methods. The utilisation of technology allows for this to be achieved. This goal is ultimately achieved by employing the ASD-SSFSML technique. Improving Mini Batch K-Means Normalised Mutual Information enables feature extraction and optimum centroid selection with the use of the Fire Hawk Optimizer (FHO) algorithm. Applying the technique allows one to achieve this goal. In addition, the Salp Swarm (SS) method, when used for feature selection, improves classification accuracy while complicating training. More specifically, we use the Radial Bias Neural Network (RBNN) classifier to hunt for spammy emails. To ensure that the ASD-SSFSML method would yield superior outcomes, a comprehensive experimental validation process is executed. According to the results of the comparison, the ASD-SSFSML model is far more advanced than other, more recent models.

articleTitle: Road Flaw Detection using CNN and Transfer Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Road cracks can have very dangerous results. Road flaw detection is a crucial aspect of ensuring road safety and maintenance. Identifying cracks and taking the necessary steps are requirements for preventing such dangers. Manual approaches are costly and time consuming. Using pricey laser equipment vehicles for operation and the associated upfront costs is also not very feasible. This paper proposes an automation-based approach to identify various types of flaws like potholes, cracks, and patchy terrain on road using machine learning techniques. The convolutional neural network (CNN) and transfer learning techniques are utilized to carry out the mentioned work. To get the precise features from the image data, first the data is preprocessed and then transfer learning is applied using different pre-trained CNN models. Thereafter, to accurately detect the road flaws, the model is fine-tuned using the transfer learning and the dataset collected by us. The proposed approach is evaluated on metrics such as precision, recall, and F1 score. The performance results show that the proposed approach performs well while achieving an F1 score of 95%. Therefore, reducing the risk of accidents and improving road safety.

articleTitle: Effective Auto Data Processing Approach Based On Combined ML And CNN For Breast Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In current era, there are various auto intelligent approaches to perform enormous activities related to healthcare as it needs. As learning concept plays a vital role to perform certain activities like learning the data’ s obtained and monitoring that patient behaviour in healthcare. As patient is concern, the heterogeneity problem occurs during the process of data extraction and prediction and also it overcome the problem of improper data accessibility as it needs to be mitigated for the patient’ s data related to healthcare. Here In order to better evaluate patient monitoring using patient care indicators like cost and staying length, we present an automated approach that integrates AI and IoT while also taking into consideration the challenge of heterogeneity. As the problem of heterogeneity is considered in the data processing to extract the data through certain set of rules to form another representation of data. Based on the pre-treatment information, post-treatment can be monitoring based on the prediction phase through modified Combined Random Forest and Convolutional Neural Network Algorithm to discuss how the effective prediction helps the doctor helps to processes in process treatment by deploying the automated framework with the integration of AI and IoT for real time health monitoring system. Here we have integrated the three phases process namely, pre-treatment, in treatment and post treatment. Here the breast cancer patient is considered, as it takes numerous numbers of small information’ s as it helps the patient to stay for longer time with longer treatment, which needs proper diagnosis for the treatment and improve the cost and staying possibilities parameters. In the performance analysis, history of the preference of the specific data and retrieve those data effectively based on cost and resource parameters to monitor health of the patient. Here the validation of the framework evaluation based on scalability and reliability improvement.

articleTitle: Data Quality IoT BoT Attack Detection using Progressive Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The Internet of Things’ development (IoT) devices in recent years has raised security concerns due to an increase in malicious traffic on a global scale. As smart devices based on IoT proliferate across several networks, so are the cybersecurity dangers associated with them. Big datasets like Bot-IoT, which train algorithms using machine learning on connections-based detection of intrusions for IoT devices, were created to help mitigate these dangers. Proper deployment of the Internet of Things (IoT) may bring about multiple advantages. It is a promising technology. For instance, Despite the fact that Internet of Things botnets have become a significant threat, there won’t be numerous full and meticulous studies evaluating the value of botnet detection methods in IoT applications. From these explanations, we developed a Conv1D-LSTM neural network for the predicting IoT BoT (Mirai, Gafgyt) attack. We also implemented a diverse. A variety of machine learning approaches involving as Logistic Regression, Random Forest and Support Vector Machine (SVM). Our analysis and experiments illustrate that our proposed neural network model can accurately classify the IoT BoT attack with 96.41%.

articleTitle: Skin Cancer Classification using Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Skin cancer detection, acritical facet of dermatology, has witnessed significant advancements through deep learning methodologies. Leveraging the ISIC dataset, this project introduces a potent approach to multi-class skin lesion classification, emphasizing skin cancer identification, which achieves an impressive accuracy rate of 90%. The methodology meticulously selects, preprocesses, and augments the dataset to ensure diversity and data quality. Centered on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), with considerations for transfer learning and strategic dropout integration, the model exhibits robustness. Rigorous evaluations, encompassing diverse performance metrics, provide comprehensive insights. Additionally, potential deployment avenues, such as API development and cloud-based solutions, are explored. This research underscores the substantial accuracy gains attainable with the ISIC dataset and the transformative potential of deep learning in advancing skin cancer diagnosis, offering hope for enhanced patient care and outcomes.

articleTitle: Recommendation of Crops and Fertilizer, Detection of Crop Weed, Pest and Diseases using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The term “smart farming” refers to the management of farms using contemporary information and communication technologies to improve product quality and quantity while diminishing the requirement of human labor and the possibility of undesirable results and loss of time and cost. Modern farmers are equipped with various technologies, including software, sensors, robotics, and data analytics. The farmers can use these to make farming a data-driven process. Conventional farming practices involve poor analysis, heavy labor, and time and financial waste. Therefore, we suggest a system that would assist farmers in combining their current farming practices with cutting-edge technologies like deep learning, machine learning, and remote sensing built using an open technology stack of Angular for the frontend, Flask for the backend, and MySQL and Google Earth for the database. Our application guides the farmers by recommending the best crop to grow and fertilizer to use using machine learning techniques, detects pests, weeds, and crop diseases using deep learning techniques, performs remote sensing analysis using GEE by obtaining the area name, and provides weather details by obtaining the city name.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Accuracy of Meal Waste from Innovative Trash Data Using Random Forest by Comparing Support Vector Machine Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The main objective of this paper is to improve the accuracy for automatic classification of meal waste from innovative trash data with the help of image processing. Material and Methods: There are 2572 images for the classification of meal waste were used for this paper. The images are labelled as “Cardboard”, “Plastic”, “Paper”, “Metal”, “Glass”, “Trash” and there are 20 number of images have been used for RF classifier taken as first set of machine learning algorithm and is compared with SVM algorithm taken as second set of machine learning algorithm With a g-power value of 80%, the revolutionary garbage data images, a threshold of 0.05%, a confidence interval of 95%, and a standard deviation, these photographs were gathered from various web sources. Results: When compared to the SVM method, which had an accuracy of 61.45%, the proposed system’s accuracy was enhanced to 84.81%, with a significant value of 0.001 (p 0.05) with a 95% confidence interval. Conclusion: This study found the meal waste from trash using the RF is significantly better than SVM algorithm.

articleTitle: Stock Market Profit Prediction Using Machine Learning Algorithms and Visualization for Live Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Stock market prediction analysis is crucial for investors looking to informed decisions about their investments. Stock Market profit prediction is based on the stocks invested. Stock Market plays a major role in our day-to-day life. Based on the trends the stocks vary. The stock market refers to financial concepts. Business and marketing play a major role in the stock market. They mainly concentrate on the demand of the sales or the stocks. Peoples or users mainly follows the current trend of investing in stocks to get the ultimate benefits. This includes various charts, graphs, and numeric representations to identify trends and patterns and identify various important information based on the stock’s dataset. The model is built based on the Live Stocks Dataset which will help to identify predict or analyze the current trends. By this model, users can easily analyze the sales and identify the current stock’s profit. Stock market prediction analysis involves the application of various techniques to forecast future price moments and trends of financial, primarily stocks. These techniques are rooted in quantitative analysis, statistical modeling, and machine learning models. The primary object is to capture patterns and co-relation. There are also other techniques to predict and analyze the stock’s sales which include customer segmentation and targeted marketing, etc. Linear regression models, Decision trees, Random Forests, etc. will help to predict and analyze the sales. The prediction of stock sales is required for Businesses to make decisions and to change market conditions. This paper aims to develop a system that can accurately predict. The model’s performance can be evaluated using metrics such as mean squared error, mean absolute error, and R squared. Once the model is trained and evaluated, it can predict sales of new products or stores. The model is trained by using the Live stocks dataset. By using this model, it gives more than 90% accuracy in predicting the stock’s sales.

articleTitle: Exhibiting the Explicit Aspects in Twitter Sentimental Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The evolution of social networks has resulted in medium to express feelings and thoughts of an individual to global audience, thanks to the rapid expansion of the Internet. Many individual utilize textual content, images, audio, and videos to convey their emotions and perspectives. However, the sheer volume of text-based communication on social media can be overwhelming. Each second, an enormous quantity of unstructured information is created online through these platforms. To comprehend human psychology in real-time, this data needs to be processed promptly, and one way to achieve this is through sentiment analysis. Sentiment analysis identifies the polarity of texts, determining whether the author holds a opinion of a negative, favourable, or neutral nature product, service, person, or location. In certain applications, sentiment analysis alone may be insufficient, necessitating the inclusion of emotion detection to accurately determine condition of one’s mind or heart. Sentiment analysis and emotion detection from textual data are both covered in depth in this work, with explicitly revealed insights into the distinct stages of sentiment analysis and the corresponding emotion models.

articleTitle: Analyzing Large-Scale Twitter Real Time Streaming Data with Manifold Machine Learning Algorithms in Apache SPARK
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: With the rapid growth of social media platforms, Twitter has emerged as a valuable source that provides real-time data on public opinion, sentiment, and trends through approximately 7500 tweets per second, enabling individuals, brand organizations, and public influencers to express thoughts, opinions, and updates in a concise manner. This research paper combines Apache Spark, machine learning techniques, and data visualization methods to analyze sentiment patterns in streaming Twitter data. The implementation leverages distributed computing capabilities and real-time streaming processing techniques to handle large amounts of data. Hashtag counting, noun counting, sentiment lexicon, and Jaccard similarity are used for the trend analysis of tweets, and Logistic regression, Naive Bayes, Multinomial Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest, and Decision Trees are used to classify tweets. One of the interactive visualization tools, like Tableau, generates dynamic representations of sentiment trends and distributions across topics or time periods. The generation of response time is combined with the measurement of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score as key performance indicators, indicating the effectiveness and scalability of the proposed system. This research contributes to the future advancements of sentiment analysis techniques for streaming social media data and opens avenues for further research in this domain.

articleTitle: Using Region-Based Deep Learning Algorithm Mask RCNN Algorithm on Image-Based Plant Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In this study, we propose a plant disease detection system that combines the power of regular Convolutional and Mask Region-Based Convolutional Neural Networks models to accurately identify and classify plant-based leaf diseases through visual symptoms. The proposed model achieves an accuracy rate of 98% using the CNN model on the Plant Village dataset, showcasing its effectiveness in disease classification. By integrating Mask R-CNN, our system offers precise instance segmentation, providing detailed information on disease-affected regions within leaf images, which is crucial for targeted treatment strategies. This paper explores using deep learning and image processing methods to transform agricultural practices that will give farmers a reliable instrument for detecting and preventing diseases early. The proposed system contributes to sustainable agriculture, enhancing crop management and ensuring global food security. Combining CNN and Mask R-CNN models offers a robust solution for efficient plant disease detection, revolutionizing agricultural practices. The model will provide farmers and agronomists with a reliable way for early disease detection, facilitating timely interventions to reduce the destruction of crops and improve food availability. This paper contributes to the field of prevention systems for automated plant disease management, promoting sustainable agriculture practices worldwide.

articleTitle: Cross Domain Collaborative Filtering: A Graph Neural Network Approach for Accurate and Diverse Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Collaborative filtering is a widely adopted technique in the field of recommender systems, aiming to predict users’ preferences based on their historical interactions with items. Traditional collaborative filtering methods often face challenges when dealing with cross-domain recommendation scenarios, where user-item interactions are scattered across multiple domains and data sparsity is prevalent. This research paper proposes a novel Graph Neural Network (GNN) approach for Cross-Domain Collaborative Filtering Recommendations to address these issues. The proposed approach leverages the expressive power of GNNs to capture complex and non-linear patterns in user-item interactions while incorporating cross-domain knowledge. The proposed research paper models the recommendation system as a heterogeneous graph, where users and items are represented as nodes, and the interactions between users and items, as well as the relations between domains, are represented as edges. To train the GNN model, mean squared error loss function is used, which jointly optimizes for domain-specific recommendation performance while encouraging knowledge sharing across multiple domains. Experimental results demonstrate the supremacy of the GNN-based method compared to state-of-the-art collaborative filtering techniques, especially in situations where the cold start problem is a major concern. The GNN-based cross-domain collaborative filtering approach not only outperforms traditional collaborative filtering methods but also exhibits robustness in handling heterogeneous and sparse data across multiple domains. The ability to incorporate cross-domain knowledge makes the proposed model a valuable tool for building recommendation systems in complex and diverse environments. In conclusion, this research presents a comprehensive investigation of the application of Graph Neural Networks to cross-domain collaborative filtering recommendations. The results highlight the effectiveness and versatility of the proposed approach, offering valuable insights and paving the way for further advancements in recommendation systems for cross-domain scenarios.

articleTitle: Term Frequency Inverse Document Frequency based Sentiment Analysis using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The sentiment analysis process can be of great help in performing post-processing tasks, such as analyzing a person’s opinion. The key goal of this research is to analyze the sentiment expressed by a particular sentence. The unstructured nature of textual data makes it necessary to parse text into logical structures so that machines can use it effectively. Furthermore, there are different linguistic forms that make it difficult to condense a natural language interpretation by matching sentences with similar semantic structures but different lexicography. Improved model accuracy can be achieved through the use of Term Frequency Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) to quantify the importance of the word. In this study, we evaluate three different classifiers: the Support Vector Machine, the Naive Bayes, and the logistic Metrics such as accuracy, precision, and recall are used to assess regression and performance. These parameters are useful in measuring the efficiency of the algorithm in accurately classifying the sentiments existing in the data.

articleTitle: Analysis of Women's Stress using Fuzzy AHP
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This study employs the Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (FAHP) to evaluate and prioritize stress factors experienced by women comprehensively. Stress is a complex and multifaceted phenomenon, particularly relevant to the unique challenges faced by women in various societal roles. The integration of fuzzy logic into the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) allows for a more nuanced and flexible assessment, acknowledging the inherent uncertainties associated with subjective stress experiences. The research methodology involves the identification and categorization of stress factors specific to women, drawing from diverse contexts such as work, family, and societal expectations. Fuzzy sets and linguistic variables are employed to capture the imprecision and vagueness inherent in the perception and expression of stress. Through a systematic application of FAHP, this study aims to establish a structured framework for quantifying and prioritizing the impact of different stress factors on women. The outcomes of the FAHP analysis provide a valuable basis for understanding the relative significance of various stressors, offering insights that can inform targeted interventions and support mechanisms tailored to women's unique stress experiences. The findings of this research contribute not only to the theoretical advancements in fuzzy decision-making but also offer practical implications for designing more effective stress management programs specifically tailored to the needs of women.

articleTitle: Empowering Hearing Impaired Communication Through Gesture Interpretation In Indian Sign Language Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Indian Sign Language (ISL) is pivotal for the deaf community in India, aiming to surmount communication barriers and promote inclusivity. However, conveying technical nuances through ISL faces impediments rooted in cultural, linguistic, and resource constraints. To surmount these challenges, a standardized system was devised, leveraging specialized dictionaries. This initiative primarily targets enhancing communication within the Deaf community, particularly in technical domains. Employing image processing techniques for input preprocessing and harnessing the prowess of an EfficientNet-B0 Convolutional Neural Network, driven by deep learning algorithms, this system generates precise outputs. Supported by a vast dataset comprising digits, characters, and expressive gestures— meticulously categorized into numbers (0-9) and letters (A-Z), each containing 1,200 images—the repository also encompasses 22 descriptive words complemented by videos, enriching gesture recognition capabilities. This exhaustive dataset substantially bolsters real-time accuracy and precision in deciphering technicalities within ISL. This innovation not only aids inclusivity advocates and organizations but also facilitates enhanced sign language learning across diverse domains. Notably, the EfficientNet-B0 CNN-based methodology boasts an impressive 99.8% accuracy and efficiency, contributing profoundly to fostering a more interconnected, inclusive society where seamless communication prevails across all realms. Remarkably surpassing existing systems, this innovation showcases an exceptional 99.8% accuracy. These advancements cater to inclusivity advocates and organizations, facilitating enriched sign language learning across diverse domains. Ultimately, this system contributes to fostering a more connected, inclusive society by enabling seamless communication across all realms, showcasing unparalleled technical proficiency with its 99.8% accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Competitive Mathematical Problem-Solving Skills of ChatGPT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The recent emergence of ChatGPT (CGPT) has been considered a machine-learning breakthrough by many for its ability to “speak” like a human and its ability to explain, tutor, and assist. In this study, the ability of CGPT to solve competitive mathematics problems from the AMC (American Mathematics Competitions) with varying type and complexity was evaluated. The problems were categorized into five fields of competitive mathematics specified by number theory, geometry, algebra, combinatorics, and computation, and then further categorized into three different complexity levels (easy, normal, and hard). Results indicated that CGPT performed the best in the number theory and computation categories but did not perform well in subjects such as geometry and combinatorics. On average, 50 to 60 percent of the problems were correctly solved by CGPT; however, it could not solve most problems of higher complexity. This point indicated that CGPT failed to correctly apply concepts crucial to solving specific problems. Therefore, CGPT was found to be weak in skills involving spatial reasoning and problem-solving.

articleTitle: Deep Active Learning Multiclass Classifier for the Sentimental Analysis in Imbalanced Unstructured Text Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper presents an active learning framework for multi-class sentiment analysis, focusing on addressing the challenges of class imbalance. The proposed approach combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) as the base classifier, logistic regression as the meta classifier, and alternative meta classifiers including Random Forest, SVM, and Gradient Boosting. The active learning algorithm intelligently selects informative instances for labeling, reducing the need for large amounts of labeled data and manual annotation efforts. The CNN-based classifier automatically extracts relevant features from the text data, enhancing sentiment analysis capabilities. The logistic regression meta-classifiers improve classification performance. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in handling class imbalance and achieving accurate sentiment classification across different classes. The active learning framework with CNN as the base classifier and logistic regression as the meta-classifier shows promising results, offering a valuable solution for multi-class sentiment analysis tasks where labeled data acquisition is resource-intensive.

articleTitle: Glaucoma Detection using Fundus Image of the Retina
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Glaucoma is often regarded as the primary cause of irreversible visual loss. Early glaucoma diagnosis is essential for effective treatment and the preservation of vision. Identifying Glaucoma Using Image Processing Techniques the main effect that glaucoma has on the optic disc is an enlargement of the eye socket. The second most prevalent cause of blindness is glaucoma, which has historically been challenging to identify in its early stages. Glaucoma is the most common cause of permanent blindness worldwide. Therefore, early detection is crucial for the prevention and proper treatment of vision loss. The development of computer-aided glaucoma diagnostic tools has improved significantly in recent years with the use of convolution neural networks (CNNs). This study offers an overview of contemporary CNN-based glaucoma diagnosis algorithms and concentrates on investigations completed up to 2021. To understand when irregularities occur, preprocessing techniques such as filtering, green channel extraction, and CLAHE are applied. The suggested classifier examines these images to determine if glaucoma is present or not computationally. CDR of the desired image. Compare the accuracy of the proposed classifier with that of rival methods. They use soft computing methods and hybrid algorithms for morphology-based image classification.

articleTitle: Datastat-Automatic Assessment Abstract Generation System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The epitome of this project is to innovative an “Datastat-Automatic Assessment Abstract Generation System” which is designed to revolutionize how colleges disseminate student performance information. The system focuses on creating streamlined, user-friendly PDF abstracts of internal assessment marks. Students or Faculty members can input marks seamlessly through an intuitive mark entry form, associating them with specific degree, department, courses, subjects and semesters. The system supports various grading systems, ensuring flexibility in assessment. The automated calculation engine generates real-time abstracts in PDF format, including total marks, percentages, and grade points. This functionality provides administrators with instant insights into student performance, facilitating data-driven decision-making and robust data security. The system’s efficiency extends to real-time updates and notifications for stakeholders, promoting transparency and enabling timely interventions. Customizable reporting tools further enhance the user experience. As a standalone solution or integrated with existing college management systems, this system optimizes data flow and ensures a seamless transition from input to output. This paper highlights the design, implementation, and evaluation of this system, emphasizing its contribution to efficient and transparent communication of internal assessment results in a user-friendly PDF format Additionally, it incorporates predictive analysis, displaying a table of students with predicted marks and a total class bar graph with pass/fail plots. The system ensures efficient, transparent communication of internal assessment results, contributing to data-driven decision-making and proactive interventions.

articleTitle: Movie Recommendation System Using R
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: A movie recommendation system is an approach to filtering or predicting the users’ film preferences based on their past choices and behavior. Such a system will provide movie suggestions to the users on some datasets. The system will track the movies a user has rated or reviewed and then use this information to recommend other movies that the user might like. This includes information about the movies, genre, cast, director, and release date. The system can use this information to recommend movies that are similar to ones that the user has already seen. This includes information about the movies themselves, such as the genre, cast, director, and release date. The system can use this information to recommend movies that are similar to ones that the user has already seen. For this project we will design content based recommendation system because of Domain-Specific Recommendations, Content Diversity, Serendipity Reduction.

articleTitle: Identification of Groundwater Potential Zones Using Machine Learning Algorithms and Geospatial Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In contemporary times, groundwater has emerged as the predominant source of irrigation in India, alongside serving as the principal provider of potable water in several regions. The rise in population has led to a surge in water consumption, thus leading to a decline in groundwater levels. Groundwater plays a pivotal role as a vital source that contributes significantly to the annual water supply. This research investigates various approaches to identify potential groundwater zones by employing geographic information systems (GIS) and remote sensing, while also including machine learning techniques. These methodologies provide a reliable means to map areas with high groundwater potential. The mapping of groundwater zones encompasses a wide spectrum of procedural variations. To effectively manage groundwater zones, it is imperative to consider multiple criteria, encompassing soil characteristics, drainage density, land utilization, precipitation patterns, land cover types, slope gradients, geological composition, geomorphological features, and contour variations. This paper examines the approaches employed in groundwater mapping, with a particular focus on the utilization of satellite remote sensing and other relevant data sources in the development of these methodologies. These tactics employ a combination of traditional and innovative approaches. Thematic layers are employed for the objectives of analyzing, mapping, and identifying groundwater potential. The evaluation of the significance and magnitude of each thematic layer is conducted in connection to the geographical location, zones of possible groundwater availability, and prevailing groundwater conditions. Maps of groundwater potential zones were generated by the use of machine learning algorithms. These maps were then classified into five distinct categories, which are as follows: very low, low, moderate, high, and very high.

articleTitle: Precision Medicine: Cascaded CNNs in Brain Tumor Diagnosis and Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The human brain serves as the principal regulator of the system, manifesting attributes that are comparable to those of the human species. Aberrations in cellular proliferation and mitosis in the brain can result in the formation of brain malignancies, which can further advance into brain tumours. Computer Vision is crucial in the field of human health as it significantly improves accuracy and decreases the need for human judgement. Traditional imaging modalities, such as computed tomography (CT), X-ray, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) examinations, are considered to be secure and dependable. The use of MRI, with its ability to identify even the smallest details, is crucial in the detection of brain cancer. This research aims to examine various techniques for detecting brain cancer using MRI scans. The study entails initial procedural stages, which include the utilisation of the bilateral filter (BF) to eradicate noise in MR images. The following phases entail binary segmentation and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) segmentation algorithms to accurately identify the tumour location. By applying machine learning techniques to training, testing, and validation datasets, the study forecasts the presence of a brain malignancy in a given individual. To assess the ultimate results, performance metrics including precision, sensitivity, and particularity will be applied. The proposed methodology is expected to provide higher performance in comparison to existing methodologies.

articleTitle: Improve the Industrial Pervasive Computing Resistance to Botnet Assaults with the use of Hybrid Deep Learning Methodologies
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The production sector has seen a radical transformation thanks to the Industrial Internet of Things, or IIoT, which is based on the development of smart, networked equipment and the encouragement of technological development. fortunately due to their dispersed the environment, IoT sensor devices, IT/OT, IIoT, and Industrial 5G integration, Edge The field of computing, and Time Responsive Connectivity are all extremely susceptible to assaults. Multivariant and continuous bot assaults may be particularly harmful to IIoT mechanisms, and recognizing they are most important of challenging. To deal with this issue, I suggest using a hybrid artificial intelligence system which protects IIoT infrastructure against sophisticated botnet assaults by utilizing Deep Learning (DL). Following a comprehensive assessment using the latest datasets, performance indicators, and DL evaluation methods, the proposed pattern recognition, or detection based on signatures, method obtained an astounding speed efficiency of 99 and a rate of identification of 99. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of our strategy in identifying and thwarting multivariate bot attacks, providing necessary assurance for industrial internet of things systems. The foundation of existing systems for identifying cyber risks and attacks that aim to safeguard the protection of disparate IIoT gadgets and produced traffic is pre-defined identity vectors for pattern identification, also known as detection using signatures.

articleTitle: Landscape Patterns in Mining Cities Influenced by Extraction and Terrain Features
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The combined influence of mining activities and the underlying terrain gradient has caused significant transformations in the landscape patterns of mining cities. The natural topography being altered by mining operations can result in a distinct evolution in the spatial arrangement and ecological dynamics of these cities. Spatial heterogeneities are influenced by factors such as extraction techniques, waste disposal methods, and infrastructure development. The inherent terrain gradient heavily influences the distribution of mining sites and urban expansion patterns. This research underscores the intricate interplay between human-induced activities and natural topographical features in shaping the landscape of mining cities. The development of resilient communities in areas that are evolving due to mining requires a clear understanding of these dynamics for sustainable urban planning, environmental conservation, and community development.

articleTitle: Designing AI to Predict Covid-19 Outcomes by Gender
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: the COVID-19 pandemic has created a huge challenge for healthcare services around the world. Understanding the factors affecting treatment outcomes in COVID-19 is important to provide personalized and effective treatment, especially taking into account gender differences. This challenge involves using machine learning to analyze patient data, identify risk factors, and develop predictive models to predict the incidence and severity of COVID-19, including the impact of gender on the disease. This will allow doctors to create treatment plans and allocate resources efficiently based on a person's gender and other health-related factors. The aim of this article is to develop and evaluate novel machine learning algorithms to predict the clinical outcome of COVID-19 in patients, including the effect of father's gender. The goal is to develop accurate predictive models that will help doctors predict the progression and severity of COVID-19 in humans, including gender-specific factors.

articleTitle: AI Based Content Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The primary goal of this application is to create a cohesive and user-centric ecosystem within a college department, seamlessly integrating essential academic functions and student engagement features. By providing centralized access to study materials, facilitating easy attendance tracking, and ensuring timely communication through a digital notice board, the platform aims to enhance the overall educational experience. Additionally, the application strives to empower students with resources such as department-specific information, career guidance, and internship opportunities. Through features like feedback mechanisms and staff details, the goal is to foster transparency and collaboration between students and faculty. The inclusion of placement data and assessment score notifications further aligns with the objective of preparing students for successful academic and professional trajectories. Ultimately, this web application aspires to be a comprehensive and adaptable solution responsive to the evolving needs of the academic community it serves.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction using Random Forest Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Because cardiovascular disease is the worldwide top cause of death, early identification and precise prediction are crucial for successful prevention and treatments. Machine learning algorithms have showed promise, with the potential to enhance risk assessment and guide therapy decisions. Age and exercise habits are all parameters included by the study. This method is well-suited for this task because of the capacity to manage missing data and find complex, non-linear relationships between variables. By analyzing the relevance of various features, the study also contributes to a improved awareness of the risk factors connected with heart disease. This work emphasis the necessity of employing machine learning technologies in healthcare to improve early detection and assessment of risk in heart disease, resulting in better patient care and decreased mortality rates. The findings indicate that the algorithm Random Forest is a trustworthy and accurate technique for predicting cardiac disease. This work contributes to ongoing efforts to develop efficient, non-invasive, and accessible methods for detecting early heart illness.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Model for Wall Crack Trend Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Ensuring structural safety necessitates the timely detection of cracks in building walls. However, traditional crack detection methods are often labor-intensive and subjective, yielding inconsistent results. In this research, we propose an automated approach for wall crack detection using machine learning techniques. Our method involves image acquisition, pre-processing, and crack detection, employing supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms, specifically Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). This approach offers heightened efficiency, objectivity, and consistency in detecting wall cracks and can be seamlessly integrated into existing structural health monitoring systems for continuous and early detection. Furthermore, our paper provides a thorough review of recent machine-learning studies dedicated to wall crack trend analysis. This review encompasses diverse model types, features, and evaluation metrics, addressing challenges and suggesting future research directions. The combined insights from our proposed approach and the reviewed studies present a promising solution for efficient and accurate wall crack detection and trend analysis, contributing to advancements in structural health monitoring. In our evaluation, three prominent CNN architectures—ResNet50, InceptionV3, and VGG16— were tested on a crack detection dataset. Results revealed that ResNet50 achieved the highest accuracy at 99.9%, establishing it as the most suitable model for our crack detection and monitoring. This study not only enhances the understanding of effective crack detection methodologies but also lays the groundwork for further exploration and optimization in the field of structural health monitoring.

articleTitle: An Estimation of the Performance of Deep Learning Based Hard Link Boot Caffe Neural Network for Network Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: As internet technology has rapidly advanced in recent years, so too has the range of cyber-attacks. In the current state of affairs in the cyber world, the ability to detect such attacks is more crucial than ever. Researchers from a wide variety of fields have increasingly looked to machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) techniques to help them solve their difficulties. In this study, we provide a system for identifying network attacks using deep learning. In this work, initially the database was retrieved and data preprocessing was done by using the Minmax error splash method. Then the attack related features are extracted using the Sigmoid polychain component analysis. Then Stochastic convergence Adam optimization algorithm was used for feature selection. The purpose of using optimization is to improve the classifier accuracy. This technique extracts a specialized features that are related to malicious code that can be used to classify the attack. The extracted features are given as a input to the Hard link boot caffe memory neural network classifier. The presented method is evaluated on a NSL-KDD dataset, achieving a high attack detection accuracy, which makes it the best among the competing approaches.

Author Keywords: Hard link boot caffe memory neural network

articleTitle: Machine Learning Precision: Predicting Oral Cancer in Cell Carcinoma Biopsy Images through Deep Learning and Analytical Insights
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Oral cancer is a pervasive and potentially fatal condition that impacts millions of individuals across the globe. Deep learning methods have demonstrated the potential to enhance the precision of oral cancer diagnosis by utilizing extensive datasets to detect patterns and provide predictions using novel data. This methodology entails the utilization of deep neural networks to examine photos of oral lesions, categorize them, and produce precise forecasts on the probability of malignancy. This study employs the ResNet 101 model, a deep-learning residual network, to assess the probability of acquiring the disease. The risk factors are examined through previous research, and the estimated magnitudes for each component are calculated from the data. Contemporary oncology uses deep learning algorithms to forecast and classify patient outcomes. This can lead to improved accuracy in diagnosing oral cancer, which has the potential to impact patient results and quality of life greatly.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-based Tamil Sign Language Recognition Tool for the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing Community.
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper proposes a machine learning-based Tamil sign language recognition tool for the deaf and hard-of-hearing community. The tool uses computer vision techniques to capture the hand gestures of sign language users and processes them using convolutional neural networks (CNN) to recognize the corresponding Tamil alphabet or word. The proposed system consists of two main stages: data collection and model training. During the data collection stage, a dataset of Tamil sign language gestures is created by recording videos of sign language users performing various gestures. In the model training stage, the dataset is preprocessed and augmented, and a CNN is trained to recognize the gestures. The proposed system achieves a recognition accuracy of 85% on the test dataset, which is a significant improvement over the existing system. The proposed tool can be deployed on a mobile device or a web application, making it easily accessible to the deaf and hard-of-hearing community.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Reinforcement Learning in Optimizing Supply Chain Management for Dynamic Demand Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Supply chain management faces unprecedented challenges in meeting the demands of a dynamic and ever-changing market.This project endeavors to explore the transformative potential of reinforcement learning in addressing the complexities posed by dynamic demand forecasting. The primary objective is to assess the efficacy of reinforcement learning algorithms in optimizing supply chain processes, thereby bolstering adaptability to evolving demand patterns. Navigating the intricate landscape of supply chain management, especially in the face of volatile demand forecasting, requires innovative solutions. Traditional methods often fall short in achieving the agility needed to respond effectively to dynamic market conditions. This study delves into the realm of reinforcement learning, recognizing it as a promising avenue to revolutionize supply chain optimization. The research methodology involves the implementation and rigorous evaluation of various reinforcement learning algorithms within the practical context of supply chain operations. By Scrutinizing their performance under dynamic demand scenarios, the project aims to identify key insights and best practices for integrating reinforcement learning into existing supply chain frameworks. In conclusion, this project seeks to contribute to the evolving discourse on the intersection of reinforcement learning and supply chain management, providing valuable insights for researchers, practitioners, and industry leaders alike. Through this exploration, we aim to pave the way for a more resilient, adaptive, and optimized approach to supply chain dynamics in the face of ever-changing demand forecasts.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Neural Network for Automated Brain Tumor Diagnosis from MRI Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The identification and categorization of brain tumors are crucial issues in medical imaging as they affect treatment choices and diagnosis. While several approaches for brain tumor detection and classification have been developed, many are restricted in their capacity to offer accurate and efficient findings, particularly when it comes to tumor localization and classification within medical imaging. Existing models frequently use distinct pipelines for tumor location and classification, resulting in poor performance and inefficiency. Furthermore, these models frequently struggle with imbalanced datasets and outcomes that are challenging to understand. In this research, we address a significant research gap in existing models by presenting a unique method for classifying brain tumors using RetinaNet, an object detection model. We tested our method using a publicly available dataset of brain MRI scans (Figshare), proving its accuracy in detecting and classifying tumors. Our approach contributes to better clinical decision support by not only achieving high classification accuracy but also providing the precise and comprehensible location of brain tumors.

articleTitle: Integration of Deep Learning and Particle Swarm Optimization for Enhanced Accounting Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Accounting fraud is a significant concern for businesses, necessitating the development of effective fraud detection systems. This paper investigates the integration of deep learning and particle swarm optimization (PSO) to enhance accounting fraud detection. Deep learning algorithms, such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), demonstrate the ability to process large volumes of financial data and identify complex patterns associated with fraudulent activities. Integrating PSO, an optimization technique influenced by swarm intelligence, with deep learning, the hybrid model can optimize the parameters and hyperparameters of the deep learning model, improving fraud detection accuracy. Data preprocessing techniques and feature engineering methods tailored to accounting fraud detection are explored to ensure accurate and reliable detection. The architecture of the hybrid model is presented, detailing how PSO optimizes the deep learning model's parameters and adapts to evolving fraud patterns. The effectiveness of the hybrid swarm intelligence approach in detecting accounting fraud, outperforming traditional methods, is elucidated in this study with suitable illustrations. Integrating deep learning and PSO can resolve accounting fraud detection. Additionally, it lessens the dangers brought on by fraudulent actions.

articleTitle: Distributed Convolutional Neural Network-Based Online Capacitor Aging Detection of DC-Link Capacitors in Power Electronic Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The mechanisms of aging in electronic components are crucial to rely on the power electronic converters. and understanding them is crucial, with capacitors being a major contributor to component failures for up to 30%. This paper presents a different approach for condition monitoring which uses a distributed convolutional neural network (CNN). The lifetime of capacitors in the DC-link is assessed through a degradation data model that factors in ESR (Equivalent Series Resistance), capacitance and dissipation factor. In addition, a three-level power electronic converter model is constructed to simulate various levels of capacitance deprivation. This paper provides a thorough summary of the degradation parameters associated with capacitor aging, along with the development of a converter model that incorporates the above-mentioned indicators.
